jobs.description:
The Associate Director of Device Engineering is a leadership position in the Drug Delivery Systems & Packaging (DDSP) department within CSL’s Technical Operations. This role will report to the Director of Design Assurance.

The ideal candidate has a solid track record in the development of drug delivery devices, from concept development through commercialization and product maintenance, i.e., sustaining. The Associate Director of Device Engineering provides combination-product leadership and ensures that device-related development plans and evidence packages are integrated into the overall CMC and product strategy. The role requires strong cross-functional and external partner leadership, engineering team management, and stakeholder management.

Responsibilities

• Lead the Device Engineering team for drug–device combination product development across assigned assets, coordinating cross-functional inputs from Device Engineering, Human Factors, Quality, Regulatory, Clinical/Medical, Procurement, Manufacturing/Technical Operations, Supply Chain, Commercial, and external partners.

• Support and mentor Device Engineering team members, developing technical and leadership skills.

• Lead and coordinate device selection and development activities appropriate to the development stage, including inputs, outputs, verification and validation planning, supplier qualification, test strategy, documentation readiness, and regulatory submission support. Own and maintain the Design History File (DHF), ensuring documentation is complete, accurate, inspection-ready, and compliant with the CSL quality system and applicable regulatory frameworks for combination products.

• Translate user needs and program strategy into product requirements, development plans, milestones, risks, and deliverables. Ensure alignment between device design, Primary Packaging, Secondary Packaging, Human Factors, and overall CMC/product strategy.

• Lead risk management activities, including hazard analysis, risk assessments, and mitigation planning. Plan and implement combination product control strategy across supply in alignment with CMC. Support human factors and usability activities to ensure the user interface, instructional materials, and intended-use considerations align with patient needs and regulatory expectations. Set and drive best practices within DDSP for Device Engineering, including standardized approaches for design risk assessment, biological evaluation, and other key deliverables.

• Represent the device engineering team on cross-functional program teams and ensure combination product deliverables are aligned with program needs. Create, manage, and execute integrated workplans, timelines, decision logs, meeting cadences, risk registers, and escalation pathways. Partner with project leads and development teams to ensure clear priorities, timely execution, and effective resolution of risks and dependencies.

• Establish and maintain strong working relationships with suppliers, vendors, OEMs, testing labs, CMOs, and other external partners to enable development, qualification, and submission-supporting activities. Support sourcing strategy, due diligence, and business development assessments related to combination products within the scope of technical expertise.

• Implement and approve end-to-end capabilities for drug–device combination development within Drug Product Development, including playbooks, templates, best practices, and knowledge-sharing approaches. Drive innovation through technology scouting and evaluation, identifying opportunities to improve patient experience, manufacturability, robustness, and lifecycle flexibility. Represent CSL interests in industry forums such as ISO TCs and BioPhorum as well as sharing information from industry forums back to CSL colleagues.

• Own program-level tracking of timelines, risks, decisions, and deliverables to communicate progress clearly. Mentor Device Engineers, promote consistency across programs,

Create, manage, and execute integrated workplans, timelines, decision logs, meeting cadences, risk registers, and escalation pathways. Partner with project leads and development teams to ensure clear priorities, timely execution, and effective resolution of risks and dependencies.

• Establish and maintain strong working relationships with suppliers, vendors, OEMs, testing labs, CMOs, and other external partners to enable development, qualification, and submission-supporting activities. Support sourcing strategy, due diligence, and business development assessments related to combination products within the scope of technical expertise.

• Implement and approve end-to-end capabilities for drug–device combination development within Drug Product Development, including playbooks, templates, best practices, and knowledge-sharing approaches. Drive innovation through technology scouting and evaluation, identifying opportunities to improve patient experience, manufacturability, robustness, and lifecycle flexibility. Represent CSL interests in industry forums such as ISO TCs and BioPhorum as well as sharing information from industry forums back to CSL colleagues.

• Own program-level tracking of timelines, risks, decisions, and deliverables to communicate progress clearly. Mentor Device Engineers, promote consistency across programs,
descriptionByLocale.de:
Der Associate Director of Device Engineering ist eine Führungsposition in der Abteilung Drug Delivery Systems & Packaging (DDSP) innerhalb des technischen Betriebs von CSL. Diese Rolle wird dem Director of Design Assurance unterstellt.

Der ideale Kandidat hat eine solide Erfolgsbilanz in der Entwicklung von Medikamentenverabreichungsgeräten, von der Konzeptentwicklung über die Kommerzialisierung und Produktwartung, d.h. Nachhaltigkeit. Der Associate Director of Device Engineering bietet eine führende Rolle bei Kombinationsprodukten und stellt sicher, dass gerätebezogene Entwicklungspläne und Nachweispakete in die gesamte CMC- und Produktstrategie integriert werden. Die Rolle erfordert eine starke funktionsübergreifende und externe Partnerführung, Engineering-Teammanagement und Stakeholder-Management.

Zuständigkeiten

• Führen Sie das Device Engineering-Team für die Entwicklung von Kombinationsprodukten für Arzneimittel und Geräte über zugewiesene Assets hinweg und koordinieren Sie funktionsübergreifende Inputs von Device Engineering, Human Factors, Quality, Regulatory, Clinical / Medical, Procurement, Manufacturing / Technical Operations, Supply Chain, Commercial und externen Partnern.

• Support und Mentor Device Engineering Teammitglieder, Entwicklung von technischen und Führungsqualitäten.

• Leiten und koordinieren Sie die für die Entwicklungsphase geeigneten Produktauswahl- und -entwicklungsaktivitäten, einschließlich Inputs, Outputs, Verifizierungs- und Validierungsplanung, Lieferantenqualifizierung, Teststrategie, Dokumentationsbereitschaft und Unterstützung bei der Einreichung von Vorschriften. Besitzen und pflegen Sie die Design History File (DHF), um sicherzustellen, dass die Dokumentation vollständig, genau, prüfbereit und konform mit dem CSL-Qualitätssystem und den geltenden gesetzlichen Rahmenbedingungen für Kombinationsprodukte ist.

• Übersetzen Sie Benutzerbedürfnisse und Programmstrategien in Produktanforderungen, Entwicklungspläne, Meilensteine, Risiken und Ergebnisse. Stellen Sie eine Abstimmung zwischen Gerätedesign, Primärverpackung, Sekundärverpackung, Human Factors und der gesamten CMC / Produktstrategie sicher.

• Leitung von Risikomanagementtätigkeiten, einschließlich Gefahrenanalysen, Risikobewertungen und Risikominderungsplanung. Planen und implementieren Sie eine Strategie zur Steuerung von Kombinationsprodukten in Übereinstimmung mit CMC. Unterstützen Sie menschliche Faktoren und Usability-Aktivitäten, um sicherzustellen, dass die Benutzeroberfläche, das Lehrmaterial und die Verwendungszwecküberlegungen mit den Bedürfnissen der Patienten und den regulatorischen Erwartungen übereinstimmen. Setzen und treiben Sie Best Practices innerhalb von DDSP für Device Engineering, einschließlich standardisierter Ansätze für die Risikobewertung, biologische Bewertung und andere wichtige Ergebnisse.

• Repräsentieren Sie das Geräteentwicklungsteam in funktionsübergreifenden Programmteams und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Produktergebnisse der Kombination auf die Programmanforderungen abgestimmt sind. Erstellen, Verwalten und Ausführen integrierter Arbeitspläne, Zeitleisten, Entscheidungsprotokolle, Meeting-Kadenzen, Risikoregister und Eskalationspfade. Zusammenarbeit mit Projektleitern und Entwicklungsteams, um klare Prioritäten, zeitnahe Ausführung und effektive Lösung von Risiken und Abhängigkeiten zu gewährleisten.

• Aufbau und Pflege starker Arbeitsbeziehungen mit Lieferanten, Lieferanten, OEMs, Testlabors, CMOs und anderen externen Partnern, um Entwicklungs-, Qualifizierungs- und Einreichungsunterstützungsaktivitäten zu ermöglichen. Support Sourcing Strategie, Due Diligence und Business Development Assessments im Zusammenhang mit Kombinationsprodukten im Rahmen der technischen Expertise.

• Implementieren und genehmigen Sie End-to-End-Funktionen für die Kombinationsentwicklung von Medikamenten und Geräten innerhalb der Drug Product Development, einschließlich Playbooks, Vorlagen, Best Practices und Ansätze zum Wissensaustausch. Förderung der Innovation durch Technologie-Scouting und -Evaluierung, Ermittlung von Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Patientenerfahrung, Herstellbarkeit, Robustheit und Flexibilität des Lebenszyklus. Vertretung von CSL-Interessen in Branchenforen wie ISO TCs und BioPhorum sowie Austausch von Informationen aus Branchenforen an CSL-Kollegen.

• Eigenes Programm-Level-Tracking von Zeitlinien, Risiken, Entscheidungen und Leistungen, um den Fortschritt klar zu kommunizieren. Mentor Device Engineers, fördern Konsistenz über Programme hinweg,
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Le directeur associé de l'ingénierie des matériels est un poste de chef de file au sein du département Systèmes de livraison de médicaments et emballage (DDSP) au sein des Opérations techniques du CSL. Ce rôle relèvera du directeur de l'assurance de la conception.

Le candidat idéal a une solide expérience dans la mise au point d'appareils de distribution de médicaments, depuis l'élaboration de concepts jusqu'à la commercialisation et l'entretien des produits, c'est-à-dire le maintien. Le directeur associé de l'ingénierie des appareils assure le leadership de la combinaison des produits et veille à ce que les plans de développement des appareils et les ensembles de données probantes soient intégrés à la stratégie globale du CMC et des produits. Ce rôle exige un solide leadership interfonctionnel et externe des partenaires, la gestion de l'équipe d'ingénierie et la gestion des intervenants.

Responsabilités

• Diriger l'équipe d'ingénierie des matériels pour le développement de produits combinés médicament-dispositifs dans l'ensemble des biens assignés, coordonner les intrants interfonctionnels de l'ingénierie des matériels, des facteurs humains, de la qualité, de la réglementation, de la clinique/médicale, de l'approvisionnement, de la fabrication/des opérations techniques, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, du commerce et des partenaires externes.

• Accompagner et mentorer les membres de l'équipe d'ingénierie des appareils, développer des compétences techniques et de leadership.

• Diriger et coordonner les activités de sélection et de mise au point d'appareils appropriées à l'étape du développement, y compris les intrants, les extrants, la planification de la vérification et de la validation, la qualification des fournisseurs, la stratégie d'essai, l'état de préparation de la documentation et l'appui à la présentation réglementaire. Posséder et maintenir le dossier d'historique de conception (DHF), s'assurer que la documentation est complète, exacte, prête à l'inspection et conforme au système de qualité de la LSC et aux cadres réglementaires applicables aux produits combinés.

• Traduire les besoins des utilisateurs et la stratégie de programme en exigences de produits, plans de développement, jalons, risques et livrables. Assurer l'alignement entre la conception de l'appareil, l'emballage primaire, l'emballage secondaire, les facteurs humains et la stratégie globale de CMC/produit.

• Diriger les activités de gestion des risques, y compris l'analyse des risques, l'évaluation des risques et la planification de l'atténuation. Planifier et mettre en oeuvre une stratégie de contrôle des produits combinés dans l'ensemble de l'approvisionnement, conformément à CMC. Soutenir les facteurs humains et les activités d'utilisation pour s'assurer que l'interface utilisateur, le matériel didactique et les considérations liées à l'utilisation prévue correspondent aux besoins des patients et aux attentes réglementaires. Établir et diriger des pratiques exemplaires au sein du DDSP pour le génie des appareils, y compris des approches normalisées pour l'évaluation des risques de conception, l'évaluation biologique et d'autres produits livrables clés.

• Représenter l'équipe d'ingénierie des appareils au sein des équipes de programme interfonctionnelles et s'assurer que les produits livrables combinés correspondent aux besoins du programme. Créer, gérer et exécuter des plans de travail intégrés, des échéanciers, des registres des décisions, des dates de réunion, des registres des risques et des voies d'escalade. Établir des partenariats avec les chefs de projet et les équipes de développement afin d'assurer des priorités claires, l'exécution en temps opportun et la résolution efficace des risques et des dépendances.

• Établir et maintenir des relations de travail solides avec les fournisseurs, les fournisseurs, les OEM, les laboratoires d'essais, les OCM et d'autres partenaires externes afin de permettre le développement, la qualification et les activités de soutien à la soumission. Appuyer la stratégie d'approvisionnement, la diligence raisonnable et les évaluations du développement des entreprises liées aux produits combinés dans le cadre de l'expertise technique.

• Mettre en oeuvre et approuver des capacités de bout en bout pour le développement de combinaisons médicaments-dispositifs dans le cadre du développement de produits pharmaceutiques, y compris des livres de lecture, des modèles, des pratiques exemplaires et des approches de partage des connaissances. Favoriser l'innovation par le dépistage et l'évaluation de la technologie, en identifiant les possibilités d'améliorer l'expérience du patient, la fabrication, la robustesse et la flexibilité du cycle de vie. Représenter les intérêts de CSL dans les forums de l'industrie tels que les TC ISO et BioPhorum ainsi que partager l'information des forums de l'industrie à ses collègues.

• Suivi au niveau du programme des échéanciers, des risques, des décisions et des produits livrables afin de communiquer clairement les progrès réalisés. Mentor Device Engineers, promouvoir la cohérence entre les programmes,

jobs.title: Vaccines Safety Sciences Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Vaccins Sciences de la sécurité Plomb

jobs.description:
Responsibilities:
• Manages and directs functions to comply with standard operating procedures, regulatory safety and pharmacovigilance and business technology quality standards in compliance with national and international regulations, such as relevant GxP guidelines and national and international legislations and regulations as well as aggregate safety reports in area of responsibility.
• Oversees evolving pharmacovigilance legislations and provides strategic direction for implementation of required changes to the global PV system; this may involve cross-functional approaches, including multiple interface functions.
• Establishes and ensures maintenance of regulatory required documents such as the PSMF, in line with international regulations, guidelines and internal standards.
• Supports the preparation and conduct of PV inspections and audits, as required and organizes or supports the back-office for regulatory PV inspections.
• Oversees/leads signal detection and management processes.
• Implements pharmacovigilance processes and ensures the uniform and timely analysis of safety data.
• Leads or contributes important initiatives to write new processes, or improve/optimize current processes in the functional area; acts as an expert on cross-functional teams for process optimization where the input of safety sciences is required.
• Provides day-to-day management support and direction to direct reports within the functional area.
• Contributes to study activities or post-marketing activities involving safety data and analysis.
• Develops and provides advanced analytical outputs to global teams to support analyses and decision making based on safety data.
• Development of new or enhancement of existing standard reports per company BT quality standards.
• Gathers, details, and documents user requirements in a way that is useful and meaningful to their business area experts and the technical team implementing the solution.
• Analyzes impact from changes to the database or changes in user/reporting requirements.
• Directs transfer of business requirements into technical solutions.
• Explores, analyzes and introduces data visualization tools to make complex analyses accessible to a broad audience.
• Business Process and/or Inspection SME/Leads for areas of responsibility.
• May provide medical evaluation of adverse event reports.
• Assists in the preparation of new drug application safety updates, investigational new drug safety reports, investigator communications, product labeling/package inserts and other reports as necessary.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor degree, Medical Documentation, or equivalent in a life science discipline or Masters (or international equivalent) in science, medicine/health sciences, or epidemiology; or Bachelor degree (or international equivalent) in science, medicine/health sciences, or epidemiology with an increased experience requirement of an additional 3 years industry experience in a related role.
• 8-10 years' Pharmacovigilance experience in multinational pharmaceutical industry.
• 6+ years' experience in a leadership role.
• Expert knowledge of national/international pharmacovigilance regulations and PV processes.
• Knowledge of local/international relevant GxP regulations, IT standards and other relevant legislations such as legislations related to privacy protection.
• Experience with regulatory inspections.
• Experience in administration of complex data sets.
• Experience in project-managing CAPA and SOP development.
• Experience with GxP.
• Experience with relevant software applications.

Different qualifications or responsibilities may apply based on local legal and/or educational requirements. Refer to local job documentation where applicable.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Responsabilità:
• Gestisce e dirige le funzioni per rispettare le procedure operative standard, la sicurezza regolamentare e la farmacovigilanza e le norme di qualità delle tecnologie aziendali in conformità con le normative nazionali e internazionali, come le linee guida GxP pertinenti e le normative e normative nazionali e internazionali, nonché le relazioni di sicurezza aggregate in materia di responsabilità.
• Supera le leggi in evoluzione della farmacovigilanza e fornisce una direzione strategica per l'attuazione delle modifiche richieste al sistema fotovoltaico globale; ciò può comportare approcci interfunzionali, comprese le funzioni di interfaccia multiple.
• Stabilisce e garantisce la manutenzione di documenti richiesti dalla normativa, come il PSMF, in linea con le normative internazionali, le linee guida e gli standard interni.
• Supporta la preparazione e la conduzione di ispezioni e audit fotovoltaici, come richiesto e organizza o supporta il back-office per le ispezioni fotovoltaiche regolamentari.
• Sorveglia / lancia il rilevamento del segnale e i processi di gestione.
• Implementa i processi di farmacovigilanza e assicura l'analisi uniforme e tempestiva dei dati di sicurezza.
• Conduce o contribuisce iniziative importanti per scrivere nuovi processi, o migliorare / ottimizzare i processi attuali nell'area funzionale; agisce come esperto di team interfunzionali per l'ottimizzazione dei processi in cui è richiesto l'ingresso delle scienze della sicurezza.
• Fornisce supporto di gestione giorno per giorno e direzione per i rapporti diretti all'interno dell'area funzionale.
• Contribuisce a attività di studio o attività di post-marketing che coinvolgono dati e analisi di sicurezza.
• Sviluppa e fornisce risultati analitici avanzati ai team globali per supportare analisi e processi decisionali basati sui dati di sicurezza.
• Sviluppo di nuovi o miglioramenti delle relazioni standard esistenti per le norme di qualità BT aziendali.
• Raccogliere, dettagli e documentare i requisiti dell'utente in un modo che sia utile e significativo per i loro esperti di business area e il team tecnico che implementa la soluzione.
• Analizza l'impatto dalle modifiche al database o le modifiche dei requisiti utente/reporting.
• Dirige il trasferimento dei requisiti aziendali in soluzioni tecniche.
• Esplora, analizza e introduce strumenti di visualizzazione dei dati per rendere complesse analisi accessibili a un vasto pubblico.
• Processo aziendale e/o Ispezione PMI/Leads per settori di responsabilità.
• Può fornire la valutazione medica delle relazioni avverse degli eventi.
• Assist nella preparazione di nuovi aggiornamenti di sicurezza delle applicazioni di droga, nuovi rapporti di sicurezza investigativi, comunicazioni di ricerca, etichettatura dei prodotti/inserti di imballaggio e altri rapporti, se necessario.

Qualifiche:
• Laurea, Documentazione medica, o equivalente in una disciplina di scienze della vita o Masters (o equivalente internazionale) in scienze, medicina / scienze della salute, o epidemiologia; o laurea (o equivalente internazionale) in scienza, medicina / scienze della salute, o epidemiologia con un maggiore requisito di esperienza di un'ulteriore esperienza 3 anni di industria in un ruolo correlato.
• 8-10 anni di esperienza di farmacia nell'industria farmaceutica multinazionale.
• 6+ anni di esperienza in un ruolo di leadership.
• Conoscenza esperta delle normative nazionali/internazionali di farmacovigilanza e dei processi fotovoltaici.
• Conoscenza delle normative locali/internazionali in materia GxP, degli standard IT e di altre normative pertinenti, come le legislazioni relative alla protezione della privacy.
• Esperienza con controlli normativi.
• Esperienza nell'amministrazione di set di dati complessi.
• Esperienza nello sviluppo CAPA e SOP.
• Esperienza con GxP.
• Esperienza con applicazioni software rilevanti.

Le diverse qualifiche o responsabilità possono essere applicate in base ai requisiti legali e/o educativi locali. Fare riferimento alla documentazione locale del lavoro, se applicabile.

Informazioni su CSL Behring
CSL Behring è un leader globale di biotherapeutics guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite. Concentrati sulle esigenze dei pazienti utilizzando le più recenti tecnologie, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e forniamo terapie innovative per le persone che vivono con i condi

jobs.description:
Associate Director, Analytical Strategy (m/f/x)

The Associate Director, Analytical Strategy will lead the development and execution of analytical strategies to support biopharmaceutical development programs. This role
requires deep molecular knowledge, expertise in analytical testing and molecule characterization, and a strong understanding of Quality by Design (QbD) principles and
regulatory requirements. The successful candidate will drive analytical decision-making, ensure robust characterization of molecules, and support regulatory submissions
with scientific rigor.

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities ​

Strategic Leadership ​

• Develop and lead the global analytical strategy aligned with program and corporate goals​

• Provide scientific and regulatory guidance for analytical plans across all development phases (discovery → post-marketing)​

• Drive innovation in analytical technologies, platforms, and workflows​

• Represent analytical function in cross-functional governance and decision-making forums​

Scientific Oversight ​

• Oversee development, validation, and implementation of analytical methods (e.g., LC-MS/MS, ligand binding assays, biomarkers, immunogenicity)​

• Ensure high-quality data generation for PK, PD, biomarker, and immunogenicity studies​

• Review and approve analytical study designs, reports, and regulatory documentation​

• Troubleshoot complex scientific and technical challenges​

Regulatory & Compliance ​

• Ensure compliance with global regulatory guidelines (FDA, EMA, ICH, GLP, GCP)​

• Lead analytical sections of regulatory submissions (IND, CTA, NDA, BLA, MAA)​

• Interface with regulatory agencies and respond to health authority queries​

• Maintain inspection readiness and quality standards​

Cross-Functional Collaboration ​

• Partner with Clinical Pharmacology, DMPK, Toxicology, Biomarkers, and Clinical Operations​

• Support translational strategy and dose selection decisions​

• Manage external CROs, academic collaborators, and technology vendors​

Leadership & Management ​

• Lead and mentor analytical scientists and project leaders​

• Manage budgets, timelines, and resource allocation​

• Build and scale analytical capabilities and infrastructure​

Qualifications & Experience Requirements ​

• PhD in analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry, or related field (or MSc with extensive experience)​

• Typically 8+ years in bioanalysis within biotech, pharma, or CRO environments​

• Deep expertise in LC-MS/MS, ligand binding assays, biomarkers, and immunogenicity testing​

• Strong knowledge of regulatory requirements and analytical validation standards​

• Proven leadership and strategic program experience​

• Experience supporting regulatory submissions and health authority interactions​

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

• Rappresentare la funzione analitica in forum di governance e decision-making interfunzionali

Supervisione scientifica

• Superare lo sviluppo, la validazione e l'attuazione di metodi analitici (ad esempio, LC-MS/MS, analisi leganti del legante del legante, biomarcatori, immunogenicità)

• Assicurare la generazione di dati di alta qualità per studi PK, PD, biomarcatore e immunogenicità

• Revisione e approvazione di progetti di studio analitici, report e documentazione normativa

• Risoluzione dei problemi complesse sfide scientifiche e tecniche

Regolazione e conformità

• Assicurare il rispetto delle linee guida normative globali (FDA, EMA, ICH, GLP, GCP)

• Lead sezioni analitiche delle sottomissioni normative (IND, CTA, NDA, BLA, MAA)

• Interfaccia con le agenzie di regolamentazione e rispondere alle domande dell'autorità sanitaria

• Mantenere la disponibilità di ispezione e gli standard di qualità

Collaborazione trasversale

• Partner di Farmacologia Clinica, DMPK, Tossicologia, Biomarcatori e Operazioni Cliniche

• Sostenere le decisioni di strategia traduttiva e selezione delle dosi

• Gestire CRO esterni, collaboratori accademici e fornitori di tecnologia

Leadership & Management

• Leader e mentore scienziati analitici e responsabili del progetto

• Gestione di budget, timeline e allocazione delle risorse

• Costruire e scalare le capacità analitiche e le infrastrutture

Qualifiche e requisiti di esperienza

• PhD in chimica analitica, scienze farmaceutiche, biochimica, o campo correlato (o MSc con vasta esperienza)

• Tipicamente 8+ anni di bioanalisi all'interno di ambienti biotech, farmaceutici o CRO

• Profonda competenza in LC-MS/MS, analisi leganti del legante del legante, biomarcatori e test di immunogenicità

• Forte conoscenza dei requisiti normativi e degli standard di convalida analitica

• Prova leadership e esperienza strategica del programma

• Esperienza di supporto alle sottomissioni normative e alle interazioni tra autorità sanitarie

Informazioni su CSL Behring
CSL Behring è un leader globale di biotherapeutics guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite. Concentrati sulle esigenze dei pazienti utilizzando le più recenti tecnologie, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e forniamo terapie innovative per le persone che vivono con condizioni di immunologia, ematologia, cardiovascolare e metabolica, respiratoria e trapianto aree terapeutiche. Utilizziamo tre piattaforme scientifiche strategiche di frazionamento del plasma, tecnologia delle proteine ricombinanti, e terapia cellulare e genica per supportare l'innovazione continua e perfezionare continuamente i modi in cui i prodotti possono affrontare bisogni medici non soddisfatti e aiutare i pazienti a condurre una vita piena.

CSL Behring gestisce una delle più grandi reti di raccolta al plasma del mondo, CSL Plasma. La nostra società madre, CSL, con sede a Melbourne, Australia, impiega 32.000 persone, e fornisce le sue terapie salvavita per le persone in più di 100 paesi.

I nostri vantaggi

jobs.description:
The Senior Manager, Clinical Operations FSP Resource & Vendor Management sits within the Clinical Operations organization and is accountable for the end‑to‑end oversight, planning, and optimization of FSP resources supporting Clinical Operations functions.
This role owns the Clinical Operations FSP workforce model, ensuring the right capabilities, capacity, and timing of resources to support portfolio delivery. The role serves as the primary Clinical Operations interface to FSP vendors and works in close partnership with the POE organization, which retains accountability for enterprise‑level contracting, sourcing strategy, and overall vendor governance.
The role enables effective decision‑making by balancing operational demand, cost, quality, and scalability, while ensuring alignment between Clinical Operations needs, POE frameworks, and vendor delivery.

Work Environment:
* This is a hybrid position based onsite at any of the posted locations with a minimum of 3 days onsite required weekly. Relocation and mobility assistance are not provided.

Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities :

Clinical Operations FSP Workforce Ownership :

• Own the FSP resourcing strategy for Clinical Operations functions (e.g., study execution, site management, start‑up, monitoring, portfolio execution support).

• Partner with Global and TA Clinical Operations leaders to understand portfolio plans, study mix, and anticipated demand across the study lifecycle.

• Translate Clinical Operations demand into forward‑looking, data‑driven resourcing plans for FSP staff, including timing, skill mix, and capacity assumptions.

• Continuously evolve and maintain resourcing algorithms and forecasting models to support proactive workforce planning.

FSP Vendor Relationship (Clinical Operations Scope) :

• Act as the primary Clinical Operations point of contact for assigned FSP vendors delivering ClinOps services.

• Manage day‑to‑day operational relationships, including performance discussions, capacity planning, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.

• Ensure FSP resources supporting Clinical Operations meet CSL expectations for quality, compliance, and delivery.

• Escalate risks and performance issues through established governance channels, in alignment with POE frameworks.

Partnership with POE (Procurement / Outsourcing Excellence) :

• Work in close partnership with POE, who own enterprise‑level contracting, sourcing strategy, and vendor governance.

• Provide Clinical Operations input into contracting strategies, SOW scope definitions, demand assumptions, and vendor performance discussions.

• Ensure Clinical Operations resourcing needs are accurately reflected in POE‑led contracts and governance structures.

• Align on roles and responsibilities to avoid duplication while ensuring strong operational ownership within Clinical Operations.

Financial Management & Invoicing (Clinical Operations FSP Spend) :

• Own financial oversight of Clinical Operations FSP labor spend, including forecasting, accruals, and variance management.

• Review and approve FSP invoices related to Clinical Operations resources, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and alignment with delivered services.

• Partner with Finance, Business Operations, and POE to ensure transparency and predictability of ClinOps FSP costs.

• Support annual operating plans and long‑range forecasts related to FSP Clinical Operations capacity.

Systems, Data & Reporting :

• Ensure systems supporting Clinical Operations FSP tracking (resources, costs, utilization, performance) are accurate, current, and fit for purpose.

• Drive standardization, resourcing algorithms and data quality across FSP resource and financial reporting.

• Develop and maintain leadership‑ready dashboards and insights on capacity, cost, performance, and risk within Clinical Operations.

• Identify opportunities to streamline processes and improve automation in partnership with POE and Business Operations.

Clinical Oper

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il Senior Manager, Clinical Operations FSP Resource & Vendor Management si trova all'interno dell'organizzazione Operazioni Cliniche ed è responsabile per la supervisione, la pianificazione e l'ottimizzazione delle risorse FSP che supportano le funzioni di Operazioni Cliniche.
Questo ruolo possiede il modello di forza lavoro Clinical Operations FSP, garantendo le giuste capacità, capacità e tempistiche delle risorse per supportare la consegna del portafoglio. Il ruolo serve come interfaccia primaria di Operazioni Cliniche ai fornitori di FSP e lavora in stretta collaborazione con l'organizzazione POE, che mantiene la responsabilità per la contrazione a livello aziendale, la strategia di approvvigionamento e la governance globale dei fornitori.
Il ruolo consente un efficace processo decisionale bilanciando la domanda operativa, il costo, la qualità e la scalabilità, garantendo al contempo l'allineamento tra le esigenze di Operazioni Cliniche, i framework POE e la consegna dei fornitori.

Ambiente di lavoro:
* Si tratta di una posizione ibrida basata in loco in una delle posizioni pubblicate con un minimo di 3 giorni in loco richiesto settimanalmente. Non sono previsti interventi di trasferimento e mobilità.

Responsabilità e responsabilità principali:

Proprietà delle forze di lavoro FSP:

• Possedere la strategia di risonanza FSP per le funzioni di Operazioni Cliniche (ad esempio, esecuzione di studio, gestione del sito, start-up, monitoraggio, supporto di esecuzione di portafoglio).

• Partner con Global e TA Clinical Operations leader per comprendere i piani di portafoglio, studiare mix e domanda anticipata nel ciclo di vita dello studio.

• Traduci la domanda di Operazioni Cliniche in piani di risonanza basati su dati per il personale FSP, inclusi tempi, mix di abilità e assunzioni di capacità.

• Evoluzione continua e mantenimento di algoritmi di risonanza e modelli di previsione per supportare la pianificazione proattiva della forza lavoro.

FSP Vendor Relationship (Clinical Operations Scope) :

• Agire come punto di contatto primario delle operazioni cliniche per i fornitori FSP assegnati che forniscono servizi ClinOps.

• Gestisci relazioni operative quotidiane, tra cui discussioni sulle prestazioni, pianificazione delle capacità, risoluzione dei problemi e miglioramento continuo.

• Assicurarsi che le risorse FSP che supportano le operazioni cliniche soddisfino le aspettative CSL per la qualità, la conformità e la consegna.

• Escalare i rischi e le questioni di performance attraverso i canali di governance consolidati, in linea con i framework POE.

Partnership con POE (Procurement / Eccellenza Outsourcing) :

• Lavora in stretta collaborazione con POE, che possiede contratti a livello aziendale, strategia di approvvigionamento e governance dei fornitori.

• Fornire l'ingresso di Operazioni Cliniche in strategie di contratto, Definizioni di ambito SOW, presupposti di domanda e discussioni sulle prestazioni del fornitore.

• Assicurare le operazioni cliniche che risolvono le esigenze si riflettono con precisione nei contratti e nelle strutture di governance.

• Allineare su ruoli e responsabilità per evitare duplicazioni, assicurando una forte proprietà operativa all'interno delle Operazioni Cliniche.

Gestione finanziaria e fatturazione (operazioni cliniche FSP Spend) :

• Possedere la supervisione finanziaria delle operazioni cliniche FSP trascorrono il lavoro, comprese le previsioni, accruals e la gestione della varianza.

• Verifica e approva le fatture FSP relative alle risorse di Operazioni Cliniche, garantendo accuratezza, conformità e allineamento con i servizi forniti.

• Partner con Finance, Business Operations e POE per garantire trasparenza e prevedibilità dei costi ClinOps FSP.

• Sostenere i piani operativi annuali e le previsioni a lungo raggio relative alla capacità operativa clinica FSP.

Sistemi, dati e reportage:

• Assicurare che i sistemi che supportano il monitoraggio Clinical Operations FSP (risorse, costi, utilizzo, prestazioni) siano precisi, attuali e adatti allo scopo.

• Standardizzazione dell'unità, algoritmi di risoluzione e qualità dei dati attraverso risorse FSP e reporting finanziario.

• Sviluppare e mantenere cruscotti pronti alla leadership e approfondimenti su capacità, costi, prestazioni e rischi all'interno delle operazioni cliniche.

• Identificare le opportunità di semplificare i processi e migliorare l'automazione in collaborazione con POE e Business Operations.

Oper clinico
descriptionByLocale.en:
The Senior Manager, Clinical Operations FSP Resource & Vendor Management sits within the Clinical Operations organization and is accountable for the end‑to‑end oversight, planning, and optimization of FSP resources supporting Clinical Operations functions.
This role owns the Clinical Operations FSP workforce model, ensuring the right capabilities, capacity, and timing of resources to support portfolio delivery. The role serves as the primary Clinical Operations interface to FSP vendors and works in close partnership with the POE organization, which retains accountability for enterprise‑level contracting, sourcing strategy, and overall vendor governance.
The role enables effective decision‑making by balancing operational demand, cost, quality, and scalability, while ensuring alignment between Clinical Operations needs, POE frameworks, and vendor delivery.

Work Environment:
* This is a hybrid position based onsite at any of the posted locations with a minimum of 3 days onsite required weekly. Relocation and mobility assistance are not provided.

Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities :

Clinical Operations FSP Workforce Ownership :

• Own the FSP resourcing strategy for Clinical Operations functions (e.g., study execution, site management, start‑up, monitoring, portfolio execution support).

• Partner with Global and TA Clinical Operations leaders to understand portfolio plans, study mix, and anticipated demand across the study lifecycle.

• Translate Clinical Operations demand into forward‑looking, data‑driven resourcing plans for FSP staff, including timing, skill mix, and capacity assumptions.

• Continuously evolve and maintain resourcing algorithms and forecasting models to support proactive workforce planning.

FSP Vendor Relationship (Clinical Operations Scope) :

• Act as the primary Clinical Operations point of contact for assigned FSP vendors delivering ClinOps services.

• Manage day‑to‑day operational relationships, including performance discussions, capacity planning, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.

• Ensure FSP resources supporting Clinical Operations meet CSL expectations for quality, compliance, and delivery.

• Escalate risks and performance issues through established governance channels, in alignment with POE frameworks.

Partnership with POE (Procurement / Outsourcing Excellence) :

• Work in close partnership with POE, who own enterprise‑level contracting, sourcing strategy, and vendor governance.

• Provide Clinical Operations input into contracting strategies, SOW scope definitions, demand assumptions, and vendor performance discussions.

• Ensure Clinical Operations resourcing needs are accurately reflected in POE‑led contracts and governance structures.

• Align on roles and responsibilities to avoid duplication while ensuring strong operational ownership within Clinical Operations.

Financial Management & Invoicing (Clinical Operations FSP Spend) :

• Own financial oversight of Clinical Operations FSP labor spend, including forecasting, accruals, and variance management.

• Review and approve FSP invoices related to Clinical Operations resources, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and alignment with delivered services.

• Partner with Finance, Business Operations, and POE to ensure transparency and predictability of ClinOps FSP costs.

• Support annual operating plans and long‑range forecasts related to FSP Clinical Operations capacity.

Systems, Data & Reporting :

• Ensure systems supporting Clinical Operations FSP tracking (resources, costs, utilization, performance) are accurate, current, and fit for purpose.

• Drive standardization, resourcing algorithms and data quality across FSP resource and financial reporting.

• Develop and maintain leadership‑ready dashboards and insights on capacity, cost, performance, and risk within Clinical Operations.

• Identify opportunities to streamline processes and improve automation in partnership with POE and Business Operations.

Clinical Oper
descriptionByLocale.de:
Der Senior Manager, Clinical Operations FSP Resource & Vendor Management ist Teil der Clinical Operations Organisation und verantwortlich für die End-to-End-Überwachung, Planung und Optimierung von FSP-Ressourcen, die die Funktionen von Clinical Operations unterstützen.
Diese Rolle ist Eigentümer des FSP-Arbeitsmodells für klinische Operationen, das die richtigen Fähigkeiten, Kapazitäten und den richtigen Zeitplan für die Bereitstellung des Portfolios sicherstellt. Die Rolle dient als primäre Schnittstelle für klinische Operationen zu FSP-Anbietern und arbeitet in enger Partnerschaft mit der POE-Organisation, die die Verantwortlichkeit für die Auftragsvergabe auf Unternehmensebene, die Sourcing-Strategie und die gesamte Anbieter-Governance behält.
Die Rolle ermöglicht eine effektive Entscheidungsfindung, indem sie die operative Nachfrage, Kosten, Qualität und Skalierbarkeit in Einklang bringt und gleichzeitig die Abstimmung zwischen den Anforderungen des klinischen Betriebs, den POE-Frameworks und der Lieferung durch den Anbieter sicherstellt.

Arbeitsumgebung:
* Dies ist eine hybride Position, die vor Ort an einem der gebuchten Standorte mit mindestens 3 Tagen vor Ort wöchentlich erforderlich ist. Umzugs- und Mobilitätshilfe wird nicht angeboten.

Hauptverantwortungen und Verantwortlichkeiten:

Clinical Operations FSP Workforce Ownership:

• Besitzen Sie die FSP-Ressourcenstrategie für klinische Operationen (z. B. Studiendurchführung, Standortmanagement, Start-up, Überwachung, Portfolioausführungsunterstützung).

• Partnerschaft mit globalen und TA Clinical Operations Führungskräften, um Portfoliopläne, Studienmix und erwartete Nachfrage über den gesamten Studienlebenszyklus zu verstehen.

• Übersetzen Sie die Nachfrage nach klinischen Operationen in zukunftsweisende, datengesteuerte Resourcing-Pläne für FSP-Mitarbeiter, einschließlich Timing, Skill-Mix und Kapazitätsannahmen.

• Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung und Pflege von Ressourcenalgorithmen und Prognosemodellen zur Unterstützung einer proaktiven Personalplanung.

FSP Vendor Relationship (Clinical Operations Scope) :

• Handeln Sie als primäre Kontaktstelle für klinische Operationen für zugewiesene FSP-Anbieter, die ClinOps-Dienste anbieten.

• Verwaltung der täglichen operativen Beziehungen, einschließlich Leistungsdiskussionen, Kapazitätsplanung, Problemlösung und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass FSP-Ressourcen, die klinische Operationen unterstützen, die CSL-Erwartungen in Bezug auf Qualität, Compliance und Lieferung erfüllen.

• Eskalieren von Risiken und Performance-Problemen durch etablierte Governance-Kanäle in Übereinstimmung mit POE-Frameworks.

Partnerschaft mit POE (Procurement / Outsourcing Excellence):

• Arbeiten Sie in enger Partnerschaft mit POE, die auf Unternehmensebene Contracting, Sourcing-Strategie und Vendor Governance besitzen.

• Geben Sie klinische Operationen Input in Vertragsstrategien, SOW Umfangsdefinitionen, Nachfrageannahmen und Lieferantenleistungsdiskussionen.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass der Bedarf an Ressourcen für klinische Operationen in POE-geführten Verträgen und Governance-Strukturen genau widerspiegelt wird.

• Ausrichtung auf Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten, um Doppelarbeit zu vermeiden und gleichzeitig eine starke operative Beteiligung innerhalb des klinischen Betriebs sicherzustellen.

Finanzmanagement & Rechnungsstellung (Clinical Operations FSP Spend) :

• Eigene Finanzaufsicht über klinische Operationen FSP Arbeitsausgaben, einschließlich Prognose, Rückstellungen und Varianzmanagement.

• Überprüfung und Genehmigung von FSP-Rechnungen in Bezug auf Ressourcen für klinische Operationen, um Genauigkeit, Compliance und Abstimmung mit den gelieferten Dienstleistungen sicherzustellen.

• Partnerschaft mit Finance, Business Operations und POE, um Transparenz und Vorhersagbarkeit der Kosten von ClinOps FSP zu gewährleisten.

• Unterstützung von jährlichen Betriebsplänen und langfristigen Prognosen in Bezug auf die Kapazitäten von FSP Clinical Operations.

Systeme, Daten & Reporting:

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Systeme, die das FSP-Tracking für klinische Operationen unterstützen (Ressourcen, Kosten, Auslastung, Leistung), genau, aktuell und zweckgemäß sind.

• Führen Sie Standardisierung, Resourcing-Algorithmen und Datenqualität in der FSP-Ressourcen- und Finanzberichterstattung voran.

• Entwickeln und pflegen Sie führungsfähige Dashboards und Einblicke in Kapazität, Kosten, Leistung und Risiko im klinischen Betrieb.

• Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten, Prozesse zu rationalisieren und die Automatisierung in Partnerschaft mit POE und Business Operations zu verbessern.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Le gestionnaire principal, Opérations cliniques La gestion des ressources et des fournisseurs du PSF fait partie de l'organisation des Opérations cliniques et est responsable de la surveillance, de la planification et de l'optimisation des ressources du PSF appuyant les fonctions des Opérations cliniques.
Ce rôle est le propriétaire du modèle d'effectif du PSF des Opérations cliniques, qui assure les capacités, la capacité et le calendrier appropriés pour appuyer la prestation du portefeuille. Ce rôle sert d'interface principale des Opérations cliniques avec les fournisseurs du PSF et travaille en étroite collaboration avec l'organisation du PDE, qui conserve la responsabilité de la passation de marchés au niveau de l'entreprise, de la stratégie d'approvisionnement et de la gouvernance globale des fournisseurs.
Ce rôle permet de prendre des décisions efficaces en conciliant la demande opérationnelle, les coûts, la qualité et l'évolutivité, tout en assurant l'alignement entre les besoins des opérations cliniques, les cadres des POE et la prestation des fournisseurs.

Environnement de travail :
* Il s'agit d'une position hybride basée sur l'emplacement à l'un des endroits affichés, avec un minimum de 3 jours sur place requis chaque semaine. Aucune aide à la réinstallation et à la mobilité n'est fournie.

Principales responsabilités et responsabilités :

Opérations cliniques FSP Propriété de la main-d'oeuvre :

• Posséder la stratégie de ressourcement du FSP pour les fonctions des opérations cliniques (p. ex. exécution des études, gestion du site, démarrage, surveillance, soutien à l'exécution du portefeuille).

• Établir un partenariat avec les chefs de file des Opérations cliniques de Global et de TA pour comprendre les plans de portefeuille, la combinaison d'études et la demande prévue tout au long du cycle de vie de l'étude.

• Traduire la demande d'opérations cliniques en plans prospectifs de ressourcement axés sur les données pour le personnel du PSF, y compris le calendrier, la combinaison des compétences et les hypothèses de capacité.

• Élaborer et maintenir en permanence des algorithmes de ressourcement et des modèles de prévision pour appuyer la planification proactive des effectifs.

Relations avec les fournisseurs FSP (étendue des opérations cliniques) :

• Agir en tant que principal point de contact des opérations cliniques pour les fournisseurs FSP assignés qui fournissent des services ClinOps.

• Gérer les relations opérationnelles quotidiennes, y compris les discussions sur le rendement, la planification des capacités, la résolution des problèmes et l'amélioration continue.

• Veiller à ce que les ressources du PSF à l'appui des opérations cliniques répondent aux attentes en matière de qualité, de conformité et de prestation.

• Accélérer les risques et les problèmes de rendement par des voies de gouvernance établies, en conformité avec les cadres des PDE.

Partenariat avec le PDE (Excellence en matière d'approvisionnement et d'externalisation) :

• Travailler en partenariat étroit avec POE, qui possède des contrats au niveau de l'entreprise, une stratégie d'approvisionnement et la gouvernance des fournisseurs.

• Fournir des commentaires sur les opérations cliniques dans les stratégies de passation de marchés, les définitions de la portée de l'ÉT, les hypothèses de demande et les discussions sur le rendement des fournisseurs.

• Veiller à ce que les besoins en ressources des opérations cliniques soient reflétés avec précision dans les contrats et les structures de gouvernance dirigés par le POE.

• Alignez-vous sur les rôles et les responsabilités afin d'éviter les doubles emplois tout en assurant une forte appropriation opérationnelle au sein des Opérations cliniques.

Gestion financière et facturation (Opérations cliniques Dépenses FSP) :

• La surveillance financière propre des dépenses de main-d'oeuvre du PSF des Opérations cliniques, y compris les prévisions, les comptabilisations et la gestion des écarts.

• Examiner et approuver les factures du FSP relatives aux ressources des Opérations cliniques, en assurant l'exactitude, la conformité et l'harmonisation avec les services fournis.

• S'associer avec les Finances, les Opérations commerciales et le PDE pour assurer la transparence et la prévisibilité des coûts du PSF ClinOps.

• Appuyer les plans d'exploitation annuels et les prévisions à long terme liées à la capacité des opérations cliniques du PSF.

Systèmes, données et rapports :

• S'assurer que les systèmes d'appui aux opérations cliniques Le suivi FSP (ressources, coûts, utilisation, rendement) est précis, à jour et adapté aux besoins.

• Favoriser la normalisation, les algorithmes de ressourcement et la qualité des données dans les rapports financiers et sur les ressources du FSP.

• Élaborer et maintenir des tableaux de bord et des idées sur la capacité, les coûts, le rendement et les risques au sein des opérations cliniques.

• Déterminer les possibilités de rationaliser les processus et d'améliorer l'automatisation en partenariat avec le POE et les Opérations commerciales.

Oper clinique

jobs.title: GRA CMC Specialist
jobs.description:
Position Purpose

Partnering closely with global and regional Global Regulatory Affairs colleagues, as well as Global Operations stakeholders, to address regulatory strategy challenges and deliver innovative, timely regulatory CMC solutions that meet evolving regulatory and compliance requirements.

Supporting digital innovation, enabling capital project initiatives, and managing strategic external partnerships by coordinating and aligning regulatory CMC strategies and activities across the enterprise.

Ensuring operational alignment of Global Regulatory Affairs CMC activities and processes with R&D Global Regulatory Affairs and within Global Operations business needs.

This role promotes strong cross-functional collaboration and effective communication across Global Operations, R&D, Global Regulatory Affairs, and other relevant CSL business functions to drive alignment and support CSL’s strategic business objectives.

Main
• Responsibilities and Accountabilities

Develop global regulatory CMC strategies for enterprise-wide CAPEX and compliance projects through collaboration with functional leaders in Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, Global Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Quality, Global Operations, and other business functions.

Assess and facilitate the use of digital innovation for Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, including AI/ML applications that manage or support regulatory submission, notification, assessment and intelligence activities. Collaborate with Procurement, IT, external vendors, and R&D Global Regulatory Affairs to implement next-generation solutions that enhance the generation of regulatory strategies and execution of regulatory operations. Define and monitor KPIs to measure impact of digital initiatives on operational efficiency indicators.

Manage relationships with outsourcing vendors to support global regulatory CMC activities. Serve as contact for external partners, coordinating deliverables, timelines, and compliance across multiple projects and geographies. Monitor performance, quality, KPIs, and regulatory readiness of outsourced operations, driving continuous improvement and risk mitigation strategies.

Monitor, interpret, and communicate evolving global CMC regulations (FDA, EMA, PMDA, NMPA, etc.). Ensure timely dissemination of regulatory intelligence to internal stakeholders and integration into strategic planning.

Coordinate key regulatory CMC activities for the Global Regulatory Affairs CMC organization, including change control, due diligence (for potential acquisitions, licensing, and partnerships), template management for quality CTD sections, deviation support, inspection support, and others.

Support the collaboration with CSL’s Corporate & External Affairs organization to support legislative and statutory initiatives to allow CSL to take an active leadership role in shaping policy and regulatory frameworks that impact the development, registration, and life-cycle management of plasma-derived therapies.

Support the development of strategic and tactical plans for Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, advising senior leadership on regulatory requirements and their implications for project timelines, compliance, and business strategy. Contribute to the evaluation of new business opportunities in collaboration with development teams.

Ensure regulatory policies and procedures are developed and implemented in accordance with applicable international standards and requirements.

Support the the creation and execution of regulatory policies, processes, and SOPs that meet global regulatory requirements while driving operational efficiency and effectiveness across Global Operations and its stakeholder network.

Support the execution of the outsourcing of regulatory activities, including performance monitoring and quality assurance, to ensure timely and compliant delivery of services aligned with business and regulatory requirements.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggetto

Collaborando a stretto contatto con i colleghi globali e regionali di regolamentazione globale, nonché con le parti interessate di Global Operations, per affrontare le sfide della strategia di regolamentazione e fornire soluzioni CMC normative innovative e tempestive che soddisfano i requisiti di regolamentazione e conformità in evoluzione.

Sostenere l'innovazione digitale, abilitare iniziative di progetto di capitale e gestire partnership esterne strategiche coordinando e allineando le strategie e le attività regolamentari CMC in tutta l'azienda.

Garantire l'allineamento operativo delle attività e dei processi di Global Regulatory Affairs CMC con R&D Global Regulatory Affairs e all'interno delle esigenze aziendali di Global Operations.

Questo ruolo promuove una forte collaborazione interfunzionale e una comunicazione efficace attraverso Global Operations, R&D, Global Regulatory Affairs e altre funzioni aziendali CSL rilevanti per guidare l'allineamento e sostenere gli obiettivi strategici aziendali della CSL.

Principali
• Responsabilità e responsabilità

Sviluppare strategie CMC di regolamentazione globale per i progetti di conformità a livello aziendale e CAPEX attraverso la collaborazione con leader funzionali in Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, Global Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Quality, Global Operations e altre funzioni aziendali.

Valuta e facilita l'uso dell'innovazione digitale per Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, comprese le applicazioni AI/ML che gestiscono o supportano le attività di presentazione, notifica, valutazione e intelligence. Collabora con Procurement, IT, fornitori esterni e R&D Global Regulatory Affairs per implementare soluzioni di nuova generazione che migliorano la generazione di strategie normative e l'esecuzione delle operazioni di regolazione. Definire e monitorare i KPI per misurare l'impatto delle iniziative digitali sugli indicatori di efficienza operativa.

Gestisci i rapporti con i fornitori di outsourcing per supportare le attività CMC normative globali. Servire come contatto per i partner esterni, coordinare i responsabili, le linee temporali e la conformità tra più progetti e geografie. Monitorare le prestazioni, la qualità, i KPI e la disponibilità normativa di operazioni outsourced, guidando strategie di miglioramento continuo e mitigazione dei rischi.

Monitorare, interpretare e comunicare le normative CMC globali in evoluzione (FDA, EMA, PMDA, NMPA, ecc.). Assicurare la diffusione tempestiva dell'intelligenza normativa agli stakeholder interni e l'integrazione nella pianificazione strategica.

Coordinare le attività CMC di regolamentazione chiave per l'organizzazione Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, tra cui il controllo dei cambiamenti, due diligence (per potenziali acquisizioni, licenze e partenariati), la gestione dei modelli per le sezioni CTD di qualità, il supporto di deviazione, il supporto di ispezione e altri.

Sostenere la collaborazione con l’organizzazione Corporate & External Affairs di CSL per sostenere iniziative legislative e statutarie per consentire alla CSL di assumere un ruolo di leadership attivo nella definizione di politiche e quadri normativi che influiscono sullo sviluppo, la registrazione e la gestione del ciclo di vita delle terapie basate sul plasma.

Sostenere lo sviluppo di piani strategici e tattici per Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, consigliando la leadership senior sui requisiti normativi e le loro implicazioni per i tempi di progetto, la conformità e la strategia aziendale. Contribuisci alla valutazione di nuove opportunità di business in collaborazione con i team di sviluppo.

Assicurarsi che le politiche e le procedure di regolamentazione siano sviluppate e implementate in conformità con le norme e i requisiti internazionali applicabili.

Sostenere la creazione e l'esecuzione di politiche, processi e SOP normativi globali che soddisfano i requisiti normativi globali, guidando l'efficienza operativa e l'efficacia su Global Operations e sulla sua rete di stakeholder.

Sostenere l'esecuzione dell'outsourcing delle attività regolamentari, compreso il monitoraggio delle prestazioni e la garanzia della qualità, per garantire la consegna tempestiva e conforme dei servizi allineati ai requisiti aziendali e normativi.

Posizione

Positionsbestimmung

Enge Zusammenarbeit mit globalen und regionalen Kollegen aus dem Bereich Global Regulatory Affairs sowie mit Stakeholdern aus dem Bereich Global Operations, um regulatorische Herausforderungen anzugehen und innovative, zeitnahe regulatorische CMC-Lösungen bereitzustellen, die sich ändernden regulatorischen und Compliance-Anforderungen entsprechen.

Unterstützung digitaler Innovationen, Ermöglichung von Kapitalprojektinitiativen und Verwaltung strategischer externer Partnerschaften durch Koordinierung und Abstimmung regulatorischer CMC-Strategien und -Aktivitäten im gesamten Unternehmen.

Gewährleistung der operativen Ausrichtung der CMC-Aktivitäten und -Prozesse auf Global Regulatory Affairs und auf die Geschäftsanforderungen von Global Operations.

jobs.title: Senior Laboratory Specialist
jobs.description:
We are currently looking for a Senior Laboratory Specialist to join our team in St. Gallen. Your main responsibilities will include the independent execution and documentation of syntheses and analytical tests; process development and production support for existing and new products; qualification and maintenance of laboratory equipment; compliance with technical, organizational and staff safety measures etc.

Key Tasks

• Independent synthesis, characterization and documentation of synthetic compounds (eg. complex iron compounds, ..) in lab and pilot scale

• Performing analytical method development

• Feedback to the laboratory manager in the event of unexpected observations during execution of experiments

• Performing qualification of laboratory equipment (execution and documentation)

• Carrying out work in accordance with cGMP regulations

• Maintaining laboratory quality systems and records of synthetic protocols and analytical results

• Apprenticeship education

• Following measures to protect health and the environment such as: prescribed in the safety organization INS020046SI

• Regular controlling of the status and utilization of staff protective gear support and usage of safety devices and protective equipment

• Inducting of new employees in the laboratory organization

• Organizing routine maintenance of laboratory equipment

• Requesting quotes for routine maintenance and new equipment

• Maintaining laboratory operations (eg. raw material and consumables, …)

• Subject matter expert for enquiries from external partners and for on-site inspections

• Creation and revision of laboratory test procedures

Your Profile

• Completed apprenticeship as a lab technician or comparable education with ≥ 3 years professional experience or

• Bachelor’s degree in chemistry or comparable education

• English and German oral and written

• Professional experience in scale-up of chemical processes

• Excellent computer skills (eg. MS Office, especially Excel; tiamoTM, PerkinElmer Signals Notebook)

• Creative thinking, curious about scientific and technical innovation

• Quick learner, adapting thinking to complex environments

• Experience in a cGMP environment

Are you interested? We are looking forward to receiving your online application.

About CSL Vifor
CSL Vifor is a global partner of choice for pharmaceuticals and innovative, leading therapies in iron deficiency and nephrology. We specialize in strategic global partnering, in-licensing and developing, manufacturing and marketing pharmaceutical products for precision healthcare, aiming to help patients around the world lead better, healthier lives. Headquartered in St. Gallen, Switzerland, CSL Vifor also includes the joint company Vifor Fresenius Medical Care Renal Pharma (with Fresenius Medical Care). The parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.

À propos de CSL Vifor
CSL Vifor est un partenaire mondial de choix pour les produits pharmaceutiques et les thérapies innovantes de pointe en carence en fer et en néphrologie. Nous nous spécialisons dans le partenariat stratégique mondial, dans la licence et le développement, la fabrication et la commercialisation de produits pharmaceutiques pour des soins de précision, afin d'aider les patients dans le monde entier à mener une vie meilleure et plus saine. Basé à St. Gallen, Suisse, CSL Vifor comprend également la société commune Vifor Fresenius Medical Care Renal Pharma (avec Fresenius Medical Care). La société mère, CSL, dont le siège social est à Melbourne, en Australie, emploie 32 000 personnes et livre ses thérapies vitales à des personnes dans plus de 100 pays.
Pour en savoir plus sur CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus et CSL Vifor, visitez https://www.csl.com/ et CSL Plasma à https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Nos avantages
Pour plus d'information sur les avantages de la LSC, visitez Comment la LSC soutient votre bien-être.

Vous appartenez à CSL
Chez CSL, l'inclusion et l'appartenance sont au cœur de notre mission et de ce que nous sommes. Elle alimente notre journée de l'innovation au quotidien. En célébrant nos différences et en créant une culture de curiosité et d'empathie, nous sommes en mesure de mieux comprendre et de communiquer avec nos patients et nos donateurs, de favoriser des relations solides avec nos intervenants et de maintenir une main-d'oeuvre diversifiée qui fera progresser notre entreprise et notre industrie dans l'avenir.
Pour en savoir plus sur l'inclusion et l'appartenance, visitez le site https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-appartenance

Employeur
CSL est un employeur de l'égalité des chances. Si vous êtes une personne ayant une déficience et avez besoin d'un aménagement raisonnable pour toute partie du processus de demande, veuillez consulter https://www.csl.com/accessibility-statement .

jobs.title: Director, BD Early Stage
jobs.description:
The Director, BD Early Stage leads the assessment of earl y- stage external innovation opportunities from Due Diligence Stage 2 to negotiation of a Non-Binding Offer ( NBO ) . The role integrates evolving scientific advances, therapeutic trends and market dynamics to guide CSL's long-range BD investment decisions in early - stage opportunities. It provides deep subject-matter leadership and enterprise-level judgement to ensure potential partnerships and acquisitions advance CSL’s portfolio impact, scientific differentiation and competitive positioning.

Responsibilities & Accountabilities

External Innovation Evaluation Leadership:

• Lead evaluation of early-stage external assets, technologies, platforms and modalities aligned to TA Strategy from Due Diligence Stage 2 through Governance to negotiation of NBO.

• Integrate scientific, clinical, mechanistic, regulatory and commercial evidence into holistic assessments of attractiveness, differentiation and enterprise and TA strategic fit.

Development of Investment-Ready Assessments:

• Deliver investment-quality inputs such as valuation assumptions, scenario modelling, unmet need assessments, deal analogues and downstream implications (e.g., biomarker requirements, specialized development pathways, manufacturing needs).

• Translate complex scientific and clinical narratives into clear, concise and decision-ready recommendations for CSL senior leaders.

Strategic Judgement and Opportunity Prioritization:

• Provide recommendations on progressing, deferring or declining opportunities based on enterprise priorities and the TA Strategy.

• Apply CSL’s evaluation standards and prioritization frameworks to ensure rigor, consistency and balanced risk-benefit assessment.

Cross-Functional Partnership and Collaboration:

• Develop and maintain key external partnerships with potential partners in close collaboration with R&D Search.

• Partner with BD Transactions to shape valuation logic, risk scenarios, deal structures and diligence readiness for advanced opportunities.

• Engage with global cross-functional partners including Commercial, Medical, Clinical Development, Regulatory, Technical Operations, Strategy, Finance to inform integrated and robust evaluation outputs.

​ Governance and Decision Support:

• Prepare high-quality evaluation summaries, strategic assessments and decision papers for enterprise governance (e.g. PRISM, REDC) and other senior bodies as needed (e.g. PDCa, IDC)

• Ensure evaluation outputs reflect analytical depth, strategic clarity, scientific credibility and integrated cross-functional perspectives.

• Support enterprise capital allocation and portfolio shaping discussions with clear strategic logic and evidence-driven recommendations.

Team Leadership & Capability Development

• Strengthen organizational capability in scientific evaluation, market analysis, disease modelling and structured diligence within the BD function.

JOB SPECIFICATIONS

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Medicine, Pharmacy, Biology, Physiology or a related discipline (required) ; Advanced degree such as PhD, MD, PharmD, MSc, MBA, or equivalent scientific/commercial qualification ( strongly preferred) .

Experience

• 5-10+ years in pharmaceutical/biotech with substantive exposure to Search & Evaluation, early ‑ stage BD, R&D  strategy  or new product planning

• Proven ability to assess scientific/commercial potential and influence governance decisions

• Demonstrated success evaluating external opportunities, leading  negotiations  and influencing cross-functional and senior-level decisions

• Experience partnering across R&D, Commercial, Finance, Regulatory, and Transactions in a global matrix

• Proven ability supporting investment cases and contribute meaningfully to diligence and strategic evaluations

Competencies

• Strong scientific literacy across modalities and early development (discovery/preclinical through Phase I)

• High analytical capab

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il Direttore, BD Early Stage conduce la valutazione delle opportunità di innovazione esterna di ore e fasi da Due Diligence Stage 2 alla negoziazione di un'Offerta Non-Binding (NBO) . Il ruolo integra i progressi scientifici in evoluzione, le tendenze terapeutiche e le dinamiche di mercato per guidare le decisioni di investimento BD a lungo raggio di CSL nelle opportunità di fase iniziali. Fornisce una profonda leadership a livello di soggetto e una valutazione a livello aziendale per garantire potenziali partenariati e acquisizioni anticipano l’impatto del portafoglio di CSL, la differenziazione scientifica e il posizionamento competitivo.

Responsabilità e responsabilità

Leadership di valutazione dell'innovazione esterna:

• Valutazione dei principali asset, tecnologie, piattaforme e modalità esterne allineati alla strategia TA di due diligence Fase 2 attraverso la governance alla negoziazione di NBO.

• Integrare le prove scientifiche, cliniche, meccanistiche, regolamentari e commerciali in valutazioni olistiche di attrattiva, differenziazione e impresa e misura strategica TA.

Sviluppo delle valutazioni di investimento-Ready:

• Fornire ingressi di qualità degli investimenti come presupposti di valutazione, modellizzazione degli scenari, valutazioni non soddisfatte delle necessità, affrontare analoghi e implicazioni a valle (ad esempio, requisiti di biomarcatore, percorsi di sviluppo specializzati, esigenze di produzione).

• Traduci complesse narrazioni scientifiche e cliniche in raccomandazioni chiare, concise e pronte per i dirigenti CSL.

Giudizio strategico e priorità di opportunità:

• Fornire raccomandazioni su opportunità di progresso, deferimento o declino basate sulle priorità delle imprese e sulla strategia TA.

• Applicare gli standard di valutazione della CSL e i framework di priorità per garantire rigore, coerenza e valutazione bilanciata dei rischi-benefici.

Partenariato e collaborazione transfrontaliera:

• Sviluppare e mantenere importanti partnership esterne con potenziali partner in stretta collaborazione con R&D Search.

• Partner con BD Transactions per modellare la logica di valutazione, scenari di rischio, affrontare le strutture e la disponibilità diligenza per le opportunità avanzate.

• Impegnarsi con partner interfunzionali globali tra cui Commerciale, Medico, Sviluppo Clinico, Regolazione, Operazioni Tecniche, Strategia, Finanza per informare gli output di valutazione integrati e robusti.

Sostegno alla governance e alla decisione:

• Preparare riassunti di valutazione di alta qualità, valutazioni strategiche e documenti decisionali per la governance delle imprese (ad esempio PRISM, REDC) e altri enti senior come necessario (ad esempio PDCa, IDC)

• Assicurarsi che i risultati di valutazione riflettano la profondità analitica, la chiarezza strategica, la credibilità scientifica e le prospettive interfunzionali integrate.

• Sostenere l'allocazione dei capitali aziendali e le discussioni di modellazione del portafoglio con una logica strategica chiara e raccomandazioni basate su prove.

Leadership del team & Capability Development

• Rafforzare la capacità organizzativa nella valutazione scientifica, nell'analisi del mercato, nella modellazione delle malattie e nella diligenza strutturata all'interno della funzione BD.

JOB SPECIFICHE

Istruzione

• Corso di laurea in Scienze della vita, Medicina, Farmacia, Biologia, Fisiologia o una disciplina correlata (richiesto) ; Grado avanzato come PhD, MD, PharmD, MSc, MBA, o equivalente titolo scientifico / commerciale ( fortemente preferito) .

Esperienza

• 5-10+ anni in farmaceutico/biotecnico con esposizione sostanziale alla ricerca e valutazione, fase iniziale BD, strategia R&D o nuova pianificazione del prodotto

• Capacità comprovata di valutare il potenziale scientifico/commerciale e di influenzare le decisioni di governance

• Dimostrativo successo valutando opportunità esterne, conducendo negoziati e influenzando decisioni interfunzionali e di alto livello

• Esperienza di collaborazione tra R&D, Commercial, Finance, Regulatory e Transactions in una matrice globale

• Capacità comprovata di sostenere i casi di investimento e contribuire significativamente a diligenza e valutazioni strategiche

Competenze

• Forte alfabetizzazione scientifica attraverso le modalità e lo sviluppo precoce (scoperta/preclinica attraverso la Fase I)

• Capab analitico alto
