descriptionByLocale.de:
Der Direktor, BD Early Stage, leitet die Bewertung externer Innovationsmöglichkeiten von der Due Diligence Phase 2 bis zur Verhandlung eines unverbindlichen Angebots (NBO). Die Rolle integriert sich entwickelnde wissenschaftliche Fortschritte, therapeutische Trends und Marktdynamik, um die langfristigen BD-Investitionsentscheidungen von CSL in frühen Phasen zu leiten. Es bietet eine umfassende inhaltliche Führung und ein Urteil auf Unternehmensebene, um sicherzustellen, dass potenzielle Partnerschaften und Akquisitionen die Auswirkungen des CSL-Portfolios, die wissenschaftliche Differenzierung und die Wettbewerbspositionierung verbessern.

Verantwortlichkeiten und Verantwortlichkeiten

Externe Innovationsbewertungsleitung:

• Leitende Bewertung externer Vermögenswerte, Technologien, Plattformen und Modalitäten in der Frühphase, die auf die TA-Strategie ausgerichtet sind, von der Due Diligence Phase 2 über die Governance bis hin zur Verhandlung von NBO.

• Integrieren Sie wissenschaftliche, klinische, mechanistische, regulatorische und kommerzielle Beweise in ganzheitliche Bewertungen der Attraktivität, Differenzierung und strategischen Anpassung von Unternehmen und TA.

Entwicklung von Investment-Ready Assessments:

• Bereitstellung von Inputs für Investitionsqualität wie Bewertungsannahmen, Szenariomodellierung, unerfüllte Bedarfsanalysen, Deal-Analoga und nachgelagerte Implikationen (z. B. Biomarker-Anforderungen, spezialisierte Entwicklungspfade, Fertigungsanforderungen).

• Übersetzen Sie komplexe wissenschaftliche und klinische Narrative in klare, prägnante und entscheidungsfähige Empfehlungen für leitende CSL-Führungskräfte.

Strategische Beurteilung und Chancenpriorisierung:

• Geben Sie Empfehlungen für Fortschritte, Verschiebungen oder sinkende Chancen auf der Grundlage der Unternehmensprioritäten und der TA-Strategie.

• Anwendung der CSL-Bewertungsstandards und Priorisierungsrahmen, um Strenge, Konsistenz und ausgewogene Nutzen-Risiko-Bewertung zu gewährleisten.

Funktionale Partnerschaft und Zusammenarbeit:

• Entwicklung und Pflege wichtiger externer Partnerschaften mit potenziellen Partnern in enger Zusammenarbeit mit R&D Search.

• Partnerschaft mit BD Transactions, um Bewertungslogik, Risikoszenarien, Transaktionsstrukturen und Sorgfaltsbereitschaft für erweiterte Chancen zu gestalten.

• Engagieren Sie sich mit globalen funktionsübergreifenden Partnern wie Commercial, Medical, Clinical Development, Regulatory, Technical Operations, Strategy, Finance, um integrierte und robuste Bewertungsergebnisse zu liefern.

Governance und Entscheidungsunterstützung:

• Erstellung hochwertiger Evaluierungszusammenfassungen, strategischer Bewertungen und Entscheidungspapiere für die Unternehmensführung (z. B. PRISM, REDC) und andere leitende Gremien nach Bedarf (z. B. PDCa, IDC)

• Sicherstellung, dass die Bewertungsergebnisse die analytische Tiefe, strategische Klarheit, wissenschaftliche Glaubwürdigkeit und integrierte funktionsübergreifende Perspektiven widerspiegeln.

• Unterstützen Sie die Unternehmenskapitalzuweisung und die Portfoliogestaltung mit klaren strategischen Logiken und evidenzbasierten Empfehlungen.

Team Leadership & Capability Development

• Stärkung der Organisationsfähigkeit in den Bereichen wissenschaftliche Bewertung, Marktanalyse, Krankheitsmodellierung und strukturierte Sorgfalt innerhalb der BD-Funktion.

GEMEINSAME SPEZIFIKATIONEN

Bildung

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Life Sciences, Medizin, Pharmazie, Biologie, Physiologie oder einer verwandten Disziplin (erforderlich) ; Advanced Degree wie PhD, MD, PharmD, MSc, MBA oder gleichwertige wissenschaftliche / kommerzielle Qualifikation (stark bevorzugt).

Erfahrung

• 5-10+ Jahre in Pharma / Biotech mit substantieller Exposition gegenüber Search & Evaluation, Frühphase BD, R & D-Strategie oder Neuproduktplanung

• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, wissenschaftliche/kommerzielle Potenziale zu bewerten und Governance-Entscheidungen zu beeinflussen

• Demonstrierter Erfolg bei der Bewertung externer Möglichkeiten, der Leitung von Verhandlungen und der Beeinflussung von funktionsübergreifenden und hochrangigen Entscheidungen

• Erfahrung in der Partnerschaft zwischen Forschung und Entwicklung, Handel, Finanzen, Regulierung und Transaktionen in einer globalen Matrix

• Bewährte Fähigkeiten unterstützen Investitionsfälle und tragen sinnvoll zu Diligence und strategischen Bewertungen bei

Kompetenzen

• Starke wissenschaftliche Kompetenz über Modalitäten und frühe Entwicklung (Entdeckung / präklinisch durch Phase I)

• Hochanalytisches Capab
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Le directeur, BD Early Stage mène l'évaluation des possibilités d'innovation externe de l'étape 2 de la diligence raisonnable à la négociation d'une offre non-bénéfice . Ce rôle intègre l'évolution des progrès scientifiques, des tendances thérapeutiques et de la dynamique du marché pour guider les décisions d'investissement à long terme de CSL dans les occasions de démarrage. Il assure un leadership et un jugement approfondis au niveau de l'entreprise afin d'assurer des partenariats et des acquisitions potentiels pour faire progresser l'impact du portefeuille de CSL, la différenciation scientifique et le positionnement concurrentiel.

Responsabilités et responsabilités

Évaluation externe de l'innovation Leadership :

• Diriger l'évaluation des actifs, des technologies, des plates-formes et des modalités externes en phase initiale, conformément à la stratégie de l'AT, depuis l'étape 2 de la diligence raisonnable jusqu'à la négociation de la NBO.

• Intégrer les données scientifiques, cliniques, mécanistes, réglementaires et commerciales dans les évaluations globales de l'attractivité, de la différenciation et de l'ajustement stratégique des entreprises et des TA.

Élaboration d'évaluations de la capacité d'investissement :

• Fournir des intrants de qualité en matière d'investissement comme les hypothèses d'évaluation, la modélisation de scénarios, les évaluations des besoins non satisfaits, les analogues et les répercussions en aval (p. ex., les exigences en matière de biomarqueurs, les voies de développement spécialisées, les besoins de fabrication).

• Traduire des récits scientifiques et cliniques complexes en recommandations claires, concises et prêtes à prendre des décisions à l'intention des cadres supérieurs du CSL.

Jugement stratégique et possibilité Priorité :

• Fournir des recommandations sur l'avancement, le report ou la diminution des possibilités en fonction des priorités de l'entreprise et de la stratégie de TA.

• Appliquer les normes d'évaluation et les cadres de hiérarchisation des CSL pour assurer la rigueur, la cohérence et l'évaluation équilibrée des risques et des avantages.

Partenariat et collaboration interfonctionnels :

• Élaborer et maintenir des partenariats externes clés avec des partenaires potentiels en étroite collaboration avec Recherche en R-D.

• S'associer à BD Transactions pour façonner la logique d'évaluation, les scénarios de risque, les structures de négociation et la diligence pour les occasions avancées.

• Faire appel à des partenaires interfonctionnels mondiaux, notamment commerciaux, médicaux, cliniques, de développement, de réglementation, d'opérations techniques, de stratégie, de financement, pour éclairer les résultats d'évaluation intégrés et robustes.

Gouvernance et soutien à la décision :

• Préparer des résumés d'évaluation de haute qualité, des évaluations stratégiques et des documents de décision pour la gouvernance d'entreprise (p. ex. PRISM, REDC) et d'autres organes supérieurs au besoin (p. ex. PDCa, CID)

• Veiller à ce que les extrants de l'évaluation reflètent la profondeur de l'analyse, la clarté stratégique, la crédibilité scientifique et des perspectives interfonctionnelles intégrées.

• Appuyer les discussions sur l'affectation du capital des entreprises et l'élaboration d'un portefeuille avec une logique stratégique claire et des recommandations fondées sur des faits.

Leadership d'équipe et développement des capacités

• Renforcer la capacité organisationnelle en matière d'évaluation scientifique, d'analyse de marché, de modélisation des maladies et de diligence structurée au sein de la fonction de BD.

SPÉCIFICATIONS DE L'EMPLOI

Éducation

• Baccalauréat en sciences de la vie, médecine, pharmacie, biologie, physiologie ou une discipline connexe (obligatoire) ; Diplôme avancé tel que doctorat, M.D., PharmD, MSc, MBA, ou équivalent de qualification scientifique/commercial (fortement préféré) .

Expérience

• 5-10+ ans dans le secteur pharmaceutique/biotech avec une exposition importante à la recherche et à l'évaluation, au début de la phase BD, à la stratégie de R-D ou à la planification de nouveaux produits

• Capacité éprouvée d'évaluer le potentiel scientifique et commercial et d'influencer les décisions de gouvernance

• Réussite démontrée en évaluant les possibilités externes, en dirigeant les négociations et en influençant les décisions interfonctionnelles et de haut niveau

• Expérience de partenariat dans les domaines de la R-D, du commerce, des finances, de la réglementation et des opérations dans une matrice mondiale

• Capacité éprouvée d'appuyer les cas d'investissement et de contribuer utilement à la diligence et aux évaluations stratégiques

Compétences

• Littératie scientifique forte selon les modalités et le développement précoce (découverte/préclinique pendant la phase I)

• Capab analytique élevé

jobs.title: Associate Director, Global Knowledge Management

This role will contribute to the CSL Data Standards, governance, and information management program development initiatives through various project, functional, and leadership opportunities.

The Role:

• Lead the strategic operations of a sustainable, world-class information management, knowledge management and insight advisory service across the CSL Group.

• Contribute to the CSL Data Standards and governance program through project participation, functional leadership roles and information management consultation.

• Manage internal/external resources to contribute to operations or key projects that support our Digital Information and Knowledge Management Strategy with a focus on AI.

• Responsible for the overall administration, organization, strategic planning, budget administration, personnel management, policy formulation and management of the Global Knowledge Management team for the CSL Group.

• Effectively manage the cost center for resources, consulting, and data collection subscriptions, including to manage contract development and negotiations for assets within the scope of the role.

• Partner with Global Sourcing when required as per the CSL policy.

• Responsible for ensuring CSL has access to the information and research to meet the business needs. Responsible for maximizing our data collection value and usage.

• Exhibits strong collaboration skills, ensuring timely exchange of insights and best practices to enhance decision-making and innovation.

• Lead, develop and implement innovative and emerging information technologies, systems, and workflows to optimize specialized information delivery models and services.

• Drives vendor relationship management and procurement decisions for key knowledge resources, databases and APIs ensuring strategic alignment and cost efficiency.

• Promote the cultural shift towards Digital Innovation, value creation and support the establishment of a data ownership mindset.

• Lead knowledge team members based in different parts of the world and empower staff through consultative and transformational leadership by developing, coaching, and mentoring to deliver high performance.

• Oversee the operations and performance of global systems and platforms including internal and external information sources.

• Implement business improvement processes through the integration of technology, continuous improvement, usage metrics to drive business decisions, and quality management principles.

L'opportunità:
Guidare le operazioni strategiche di una gestione della conoscenza sostenibile e di un servizio di consulenza intuitiva di livello mondiale in tutto il Gruppo CSL. Con un focus sulla leadership e l'innovazione, questo ruolo è responsabile per l'amministrazione generale, l'organizzazione, la governance, la pianificazione strategica, l'amministrazione di bilancio e la gestione del personale del team Global Knowledge Management (GKM).

Questo ruolo contribuirà alle iniziative di sviluppo del programma CSL Data Standards, governance e gestione delle informazioni attraverso varie opportunità di progetto, funzionali e di leadership.

Il ruolo:

• Guidare le operazioni strategiche di una gestione dell'informazione sostenibile e di livello mondiale, la gestione della conoscenza e il servizio di consulenza intuitiva in tutto il Gruppo CSL.

• Contribuisci al programma CSL Data Standards e governance attraverso la partecipazione del progetto, i ruoli di leadership funzionali e la consultazione della gestione delle informazioni.

• Gestire risorse interne/esterne per contribuire a operazioni o progetti chiave che supportano la nostra strategia di gestione delle informazioni e delle conoscenze digitali con un focus sull'intelligenza artificiale.

• Responsabile per l'amministrazione generale, l'organizzazione, la pianificazione strategica, l'amministrazione di bilancio, la gestione del personale, la formulazione politica e la gestione del team Global Knowledge Management per il Gruppo CSL.

• Efficacemente gestire il centro di costo per le risorse, la consulenza e gli abbonamenti di raccolta dati, tra cui gestire lo sviluppo del contratto e i negoziati per le attività nell'ambito del ruolo.

• Partner con Global Sourcing quando richiesto secondo la politica CSL.

• Responsabile per garantire che CSL abbia accesso alle informazioni e alla ricerca per soddisfare le esigenze aziendali. Responsabile per massimizzare il valore e l'utilizzo della raccolta dati.

• Responsabile di costruire e mantenere attivamente relazioni professionali con i servizi di conoscenza interni ed esterni, comprese le risorse di biblioteca farmaceutica, i consorzi industriali e le reti peer.

• Leva queste connessioni per accedere, condividere e applicare le informazioni scientifiche, regolamentari e di settore rilevanti che supportano gli obiettivi organizzativi.

• Sfrutta forti competenze di collaborazione, garantendo uno scambio tempestivo di intuizioni e migliori pratiche per migliorare il processo decisionale e l'innovazione.

jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

• The Global Asset Integrity & Lifecycle Lead is essential in developing and managing a strategy focused on the effectiveness and safety of critical assets. This role oversees the entire asset lifecycle, from design and commissioning to maintenance and decommissioning, ensuring compliance with global standards while prioritizing cost-effectiveness.

• Collaboration with regionalteams, engineering, operational units, maintenance crews, and digital technology specialists enhances asset performance and reduces risks. This collective effort ensures that assets meetcurrent demands and are prepared for future challenges.

The Role:

• Strategy & Governance-

• Develop a global strategy for asset integrity and lifecycle management, with clear standards and governance for effective oversight.

• Implement lifecycle risk management policies across all asset stages—design, inspection, maintenance, and end-of-life—to mitigate risks and enhance performance.

• Ensure compliance with global regulations and industry standards while integrating practices into safety management systems to foster a culture of safety.

• Conduct maturity assessments of asset integrity and reliability, creating continuous improvement roadmaps for enhancing these areas over time.

• Performance & Reliability Optimization-

• Establish comprehensive global KPI frameworks that specifically focus on three critical areas: availability, maintainability, and lifecycle performance.

• These frameworks will serve as a foundation for measuring and enhancing asset management effectiveness across the organization.

• In addition, conduct thorough benchmarking of asset performance on a global scale to identify areas of improvement.

• This process will also facilitate the widespread adoption of industry best practices across different business units, ensuring that all teams are aligned and working towards optimizing asset efficiency and reliability.

• Compliance, Risk & Assurance -

• Ensure that all operations are fully compliant with relevant global regulatory requirements, industry standards such as ISO 55000, API, and ASME, as well as internal company policies governing asset integrity and lifecycle management.

• Take charge of comprehensive risk assessment processes, which encompass conducting in-depth hazard studies, performing failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA), and executing thorough integrity risk reviews to identify potential vulnerabilities.

• Provide support for both internal and external audits focused on asset integrity and lifecycle management, ensuring that all findings are meticulously documented and addressed in accordance with best practices and compliance mandates.

• Leadership & Stakeholder Collaboration -

• Collaborate with regional operations, engineering, HSE, supply chain, project engineering, and finance for cohesive lifecycle planning of assets.

• Lead global and regional asset integrity teams, fostering a culture of safety and reliability in all activities.

• Represent asset integrity in corporate risk committees and project evaluations, ensuring our priorities are integrated into strategic decisions.

• Asset Lifecycle Management -

• Manage the planning of asset lifecycles from acquisition to decommissioning.

• This includes overseeing the commissioning of new assets, optimizing their performance, extending the life of existing assets, and ensuring safe decommissioning.

• Implement standardized methods for condition assessments, life-extension studies, and asset classification to evaluate risks and opportunities accurately.

• Ensure capital planning includes lifecycle cost analysis (LCCA) for informed financial decisions, focusing on long-term reliability and sustainability.

• Digital Transformation & Data Management-

• Drive adoption of digital tools such as APM (Asset Performance Management) systems, CMMS/EAM platforms, predictive analytics, and IoT monitoring.

• Oversee global asset data standards, taxonom

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità:

• Il Global Asset Integrity & Lifecycle Lead è essenziale nello sviluppo e nella gestione di una strategia focalizzata sull'efficacia e sulla sicurezza dei beni critici. Questo ruolo supervisiona l'intero ciclo di vita degli asset, dalla progettazione e messa in servizio alla manutenzione e al decommissioning, garantendo il rispetto degli standard globali e privilegiando l'efficienza dei costi.

• La collaborazione con i team regionali, l'ingegneria, le unità operative, gli equipaggi di manutenzione e gli specialisti della tecnologia digitale migliora le prestazioni degli asset e riduce i rischi. Questo sforzo collettivo assicura che i beni soddisfino le richieste attuali e siano preparati per le sfide future.

Il ruolo:

• Strategia e governance

• Sviluppare una strategia globale per l'integrità degli asset e la gestione del ciclo di vita, con standard chiari e governance per una supervisione efficace.

• Implementare le politiche di gestione del rischio del ciclo di vita in tutte le fasi di attività, progettazione, ispezione, manutenzione e fine vita, per mitigare i rischi e migliorare le prestazioni.

• Garantire la conformità alle normative globali e agli standard del settore, integrando le pratiche nei sistemi di gestione della sicurezza per promuovere una cultura della sicurezza.

• Condurre valutazioni di maturità dell'integrità e dell'affidabilità degli asset, creando roadmap di miglioramento continuo per migliorare queste aree nel tempo.

• Ottimizzazione delle prestazioni e affidabilità

• Stabilire framework KPI globali completi che si concentrano specificamente su tre aree critiche: disponibilità, manutenbilità e prestazioni del ciclo di vita.

• Questi quadri fungeranno da base per misurare e migliorare l'efficacia della gestione patrimoniale in tutta l'organizzazione.

• Inoltre, condurre un accurato benchmarking delle prestazioni di asset su scala globale per identificare le aree di miglioramento.

• Questo processo faciliterà anche l'adozione diffusa delle migliori pratiche del settore in diverse unità aziendali, assicurando che tutte le squadre siano allineate e lavorando per ottimizzare l'efficienza e l'affidabilità degli asset.

• Compliance, Rischio e Assicurazione -

• Assicurarsi che tutte le operazioni siano pienamente conformi ai requisiti normativi globali pertinenti, agli standard del settore come ISO 55000, API e ASME, nonché alle politiche aziendali interne che regolano l'integrità degli asset e la gestione del ciclo di vita.

• Prendersi carico di processi di valutazione del rischio completi, che comprendono la conduzione di studi di rischio approfonditi, l'esecuzione di modalità di guasto e l'analisi degli effetti (FMEA), e l'esecuzione di recensioni approfondite sul rischio di integrità per identificare potenziali vulnerabilità.

• Fornire supporto per audit sia interni che esterni focalizzati sull'integrità degli asset e sulla gestione del ciclo di vita, assicurando che tutti i risultati siano meticolosamente documentati e affrontati in conformità con le migliori pratiche e mandati di conformità.

• Leadership & Stakeholder Collaboration -

• Collabora con le operazioni regionali, l'ingegneria, HSE, la supply chain, l'ingegneria del progetto e la finanza per la pianificazione del ciclo di vita coesa dei beni.

• Leader team di integrità patrimoniale globale e regionale, promuovendo una cultura di sicurezza e affidabilità in tutte le attività.

• Rappresentare l'integrità degli asset nei comitati di rischio aziendali e nelle valutazioni dei progetti, assicurando che le nostre priorità siano integrate in decisioni strategiche.

• Gestione del ciclo di vita -

• Gestire la pianificazione dei cicli di vita degli asset dall'acquisizione alla decommissione.

• Ciò include la supervisione della messa in servizio di nuovi asset, l'ottimizzazione delle loro prestazioni, l'estensione della vita dei beni esistenti, e la garanzia di decommissione sicura.

• Implementare metodi standardizzati per le valutazioni delle condizioni, gli studi sull'estensione della vita e la classificazione degli asset per valutare i rischi e le opportunità con precisione.

• Assicurare la pianificazione dei capitali include l'analisi dei costi del ciclo di vita (LCCA) per le decisioni finanziarie informate, concentrandosi sull'affidabilità a lungo termine e sulla sostenibilità.

• Trasformazione digitale e gestione dei dati

• Adozione di unità di strumenti digitali come sistemi APM (Asset Performance Management), piattaforme CMMS/EAM, analisi predittiva e monitoraggio IoT.

• Controllare gli standard globali dei dati degli asset, taxonom

Die Gelegenheit:

Diese Rolle überwacht den gesamten Asset-Lebenszyklus, von der Planung und Inbetriebnahme bis hin zur Wartung und Stilllegung, um die Einhaltung globaler Standards zu gewährleisten und gleichzeitig die Wirtschaftlichkeit zu priorisieren.

• Die Zusammenarbeit mit regionalen Teams, Ingenieuren, operativen Einheiten, Wartungsteams und Spezialisten für digitale Technologie verbessert die Anlagenleistung und reduziert Risiken. Diese gemeinsame Anstrengung stellt sicher, dass die Vermögenswerte den aktuellen Anforderungen entsprechen und auf zukünftige Herausforderungen vorbereitet sind.

Die Rolle:

• Strategie & Governance-

• Entwicklung einer globalen Strategie für Asset-Integrity und Lifecycle-Management mit klaren Standards und Governance für eine effektive Aufsicht.

• Implementieren Sie Lifecycle-Risikomanagement-Richtlinien in allen Asset-Phasen - Design, Inspektion, Wartung und Ende der Lebensdauer -, um Risiken zu mindern und die Leistung zu verbessern.

• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung globaler Vorschriften und Industriestandards bei gleichzeitiger Integration von Praktiken in Sicherheitsmanagementsysteme zur Förderung einer Sicherheitskultur.

• Durchführung von Fälligkeitsbewertungen der Integrität und Zuverlässigkeit von Vermögenswerten und Erstellung von Roadmaps zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung dieser Bereiche im Laufe der Zeit.

• Performance & Zuverlässigkeit Optimierung-

• Etablieren Sie umfassende globale KPI-Frameworks, die sich speziell auf drei kritische Bereiche konzentrieren: Verfügbarkeit, Wartbarkeit und Lebenszyklusleistung.

• Diese Frameworks dienen als Grundlage für die Messung und Verbesserung der Wirksamkeit des Asset Managements im gesamten Unternehmen.

• Darüber hinaus führen Sie ein gründliches Benchmarking der Vermögensperformance auf globaler Ebene durch, um Verbesserungsbereiche zu identifizieren.

• Dieser Prozess wird auch die weit verbreitete Übernahme von Best Practices der Branche in verschiedenen Geschäftseinheiten erleichtern, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Teams aufeinander abgestimmt sind und auf die Optimierung der Anlageneffizienz und -zuverlässigkeit hinarbeiten.

• Compliance, Risk & Assurance -

descriptionByLocale.fr:

Ce rôle supervise l'ensemble du cycle de vie de l'actif, de la conception et de la mise en service à l'entretien et au déclassement, en veillant au respect des normes mondiales tout en accordant la priorité à la rentabilité.

• La collaboration avec les équipes régionales, le génie, les unités opérationnelles, les équipes de maintenance et les spécialistes de la technologie numérique améliore la performance des actifs et réduit les risques. Cet effort collectif garantit que les actifs répondent aux exigences actuelles et sont préparés aux défis futurs.

Le rôle :

• Stratégie et gouvernance

• Élaborer une stratégie globale pour l'intégrité des biens et la gestion du cycle de vie, assortie de normes claires et d'une gouvernance permettant une surveillance efficace.

• Mettre en oeuvre des politiques de gestion des risques du cycle de vie à toutes les étapes de l'actif – conception, inspection, entretien et fin de vie – afin d'atténuer les risques et d'améliorer le rendement.

• Assurer le respect des règlements mondiaux et des normes de l'industrie tout en intégrant les pratiques dans les systèmes de gestion de la sécurité pour favoriser une culture de la sécurité.

• Effectuer des évaluations de l'intégrité et de la fiabilité des actifs à l'échéance, en créant des feuilles de route pour améliorer ces domaines au fil du temps.

jobs.description:
Senior EHS Expert – Risk Management & Technical Safety (f/m/d)

Ihre Mission

Als Senior EHS Expert – Risk Management & Technical Safety übernehmen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung für das Risikomanagement und die technische Sicherheit am Standort Bern.

Sie fungieren als Subject Matter Expert (SME) für Risk Management, Technical Safety und Incident Investigation und begleiten technische Projekte über den gesamten Lebenszyklus. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit Engineering, Operations, Quality und EHS zusammen und treiben die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Sicherheitsstandards am Standort voran.

Ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der Rolle ist die fachliche Unterstützung und Weiterentwicklung von EHS-Fachspezialist:innen sowie die Beratung von Führungskräften und Projektteams.

Bitte bewerben Sie sich insbesondere dann, wenn Sie Risikoanalysen (z. B. HAZOP, Bow Tie oder FMEA), Incident Investigations oder Technical-Safety-Bewertungen bereits selbstständig moderiert und durchgeführt haben sowie Erfahrung in der fachlichen Entwicklung und Begleitung anderer Fachpersonen mitbringen.

Dies ist keine klassische EHS-Generalistenrolle. Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit mit fundierter Erfahrung in Technical Safety, Risikomanagement und der Moderation komplexer Risikoanalysen.

Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten

Risk Management & Hazard Analysis

• Moderation und Durchführung von Risikoanalysen und Gefährdungsbeurteilungen (HAZOP, Bow Tie, FMEA, JSA)

• Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung des standortweiten Risk Registers

• Entwicklung von Risikominderungsstrategien für Prozesse, Anlagen und Tätigkeiten

• Sicherstellung einer konsistenten Vorgehensweise gemäss ISO 45001 und CSL Technical Standards

Technical Safety & Incident Investigation

• Durchführung technischer Sicherheitsbewertungen

• Leitung von pSIF-Untersuchungen und Root-Cause-Analysen (ICAM, TapRooT®, RCA)

• Definition und Nachverfolgung nachhaltiger Präventionsmassnahmen

• Überführung von Lessons Learned in Standards, SOPs und Trainings

Engineering & Projekte

• EHS-Begleitung von Bau-, Modernisierungs- und Anlagenprojekten

• Teilnahme an Design Reviews, HAZOPs, PSSR, Change Controls und technischen Abnahmen

• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung globaler Technical Standards

• Fachliche Koordination von EHS-Aktivitäten im Projektumfeld

Coaching & Stakeholder Management

• Fachliche Unterstützung und Mentoring von EHS-Spezialist:innen

• Beratung von Führungskräften und Projektteams zu technischen Risiken

• Moderation von Workshops und risikobasierten Entscheidungsprozessen

• Förderung einer nachhaltigen Sicherheits- und Risikokultur

Compliance & Managementsystem

• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von ISO 45001, Schweizer Gesetzgebung und CSL Standards

• Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen, Standards und Arbeitsanweisungen

• Unterstützung bei Audits, Inspektionen und Behördenkontakten

Anforderungen & Qualifikationen

Erfahrung

• 5 bis 8 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in Technical Safety, Process Safety, Risk Engineering oder EHS in einem technisch anspruchsvollen Umfeld

• Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Moderation von Risikoanalysen und Gefährdungsbeurteilungen

• Erfahrung in Incident Investigations und Root-Cause-Methoden

• Erfahrung in der Begleitung technischer Projekte

• Erfahrung im Coaching, Mentoring oder der fachlichen Anleitung von Fachpersonen

Fachliche Qualifikationen

• Studium in Sicherheitstechnik, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Verfahrenstechnik, Umweltwissenschaften oder vergleichbarer Fachrichtung

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in:
• ISO 45001

• Risk Management

• Technical Safety

• Maschinen- und Anlagensicherheit

• Gefahrstoffmanagement

Persönliche Kompetenzen

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Moderationsfähigkeiten

• Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Risiken verständlich zu vermitteln

• Proaktive, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Fachspezialist:innen, Führungskräften und Projektteams

• Garantire il rispetto degli standard tecnici globali

• Coordinamento professionale delle attività EHS nell'ambiente di progetto

Coaching & Stakeholder Management

• Supporto tecnico e mentoring degli specialisti EHS: dentro

• Consulenza di dirigenti e team di progetto sui rischi tecnici

• Moderazione di workshop e processi decisionali basati sui rischi

• Promuovere una cultura sostenibile della sicurezza e del rischio

Sistema di conformità e gestione

• Garantire il rispetto delle norme ISO 45001, legislazione svizzera e CSL

• Ulteriore sviluppo di processi, standard e istruzioni di lavoro

• Sostegno agli audit, ispezioni e contatti con le autorità

Requisiti e qualifiche

Esperienza

• da 5 a 8 anni di esperienza professionale rilevante in sicurezza tecnica, sicurezza dei processi, ingegneria dei rischi o EHS in un ambiente tecnico esigente

• Esperienza nelle indagini sugli incidenti e nei metodi di root-cause

• Esperienza nell'accompagnamento di progetti tecnici

• Esperienza in coaching, mentoring o la guida professionale di specialisti

Qualifiche professionali

• Studi in ingegneria della sicurezza, ingegneria, chimica, ingegneria dei processi, scienze ambientali o disciplina comparabile

• Conoscenza approfondita di:
• ISO 45001

• Gestione del rischio

• Sicurezza tecnica

• Sicurezza delle macchine e degli impianti

• Gestione dei materiali pericolosi

Competenze personali

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e moderazione

• Apparenza sicura verso specialisti: dentro, manager e team di progetto

Senior EHS Expert – Risk Management & Technical Safety (m/f/d)

Their mission

As a Senior EHS Expert – Risk Management & Technical Safety, you take on the professional responsibility for risk management and technical safety at the Bern site.

They act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Risk Management, Technical Safety and Incident Investigation and accompany technical projects throughout the entire life cycle. You will work closely with Engineering, Operations, Quality and EHS and drive the continuous development of safety standards at the site.

An essential part of the role is the technical support and further development of EHS specialists as well as the advice of executives and project teams.

Please apply in particular if you have already independently moderated and carried out risk analyses (e.g. HAZOP, Bow Tie or FMEA), incident investigations or technical safety assessments and have experience in the professional development and support of other specialists.

This is not a classic EHS generalist role. We are looking for a person with deep experience in technical safety, risk management and moderation of complex risk analysis.

Main tasks and responsibilities

Risk management and hazard analysis

• Moderation and implementation of risk analyses and risk assessments (HAZOP, Bow Tie, FMEA, JSA)

• Establishment and further development of the site-wide risk register

• Development of risk mitigation strategies for processes, facilities and activities

• Ensuring a consistent approach in accordance with ISO 45001 and CSL Technical Standards

Technical safety and incident investigation

• Conduct of technical safety assessments

• Leading pSIF investigations and root cause analyses (ICAM, TapRooT®, RCA)

• Definition and follow-up of sustainable prevention measures

• Translating Lessons Learned into Standards, SOPs and Training

Engineering and Projects

• EHS support for construction, modernisation and plant projects

• Participation in Design Reviews, HAZOPs, PSSR, Change Controls and Technical Acceptance

• Ensuring compliance with global technical standards

• Professional coordination of EHS activities in the project environment

Coaching & Stakeholder Management

• Technical support and mentoring of EHS specialists: inside

• Advising executives and project teams on technical risks

• Moderation of workshops and risk based decision-making processes

• Promoting a sustainable safety and risk culture

Compliance and Management System

• Ensuring compliance with ISO 45001, Swiss legislation and CSL standards

• Further development of processes, standards and work instructions

• Support for audits, inspections and contacts with authorities

Requirements and qualifications

Experience

• 5 to 8 years of relevant professional experience in technical safety, process safety, risk engineering or EHS in a technically demanding environment

• Demonstrate experience in facilitating risk analysis and risk assessment

• Experience in incident investigations and root-cause methods

• Experience in accompanying technical projects

• Experience in coaching, mentoring or the professional guidance of specialists

Professional qualifications

• Studies in safety engineering, engineering, chemistry, process engineering, environmental sciences or comparable discipline

• In-depth knowledge of:
• ISO 45001

• Risk management

• Technical safety

• Machinery and plant safety

• Hazardous materials management

Personal competences

• Strong communication and moderation capabilities

• Ability to understandably convey complex technical risks

• Proactive, structured and solution-oriented workflow

• Secure appearance towards specialists: inside, managers and project teams

About the role

As Principal EHS Specialist (m/f/d), you support the Berne location in all central topics of health, safety and environmental management.
They bring in-depth EHS expertise, strong shop floor proximity and the ability to coach executives, teams and EHS colleagues and accompany them in their development. You combine operational presence with strategic thinking and make a significant contribution to the further development of our health, safety and environmental culture.

This role is aimed at experienced EHS professionals who want to not only use their expertise to solve problems, but actively contribute to the development of people, teams and organizations.

Main tasks and responsibilities

Coaching, mentoring and cultural development

• Coach and sparring partner for executives, employees and EHS professionals

• Supporting the professional development of EHS team members

• Promoting an open learning, feedback and safety culture

• Providing best practices and lessons learned

• Supporting leaders in their EHS responsibilities

• Promoting ownership and a sustainable safety culture at all levels

• Contribution to the further development of the EHS organisation at the site

Presence in operation and support of the shop floor

• Implementation of safety, health and environmental walks

• Emissions control

• Energy efficiency

• Sewage

• Hazardous materials management

• Resource management

• Sustainability initiatives

• Implementation of Environmental Walks

jobs.title: Clinical Trial Supply (CTS) Study Manager

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de l'étude sur l'approvisionnement en essais cliniques

jobs.description:
Work Environment:

* This is a hybrid position based onsite at any of the posted locations with a minimum of 3 days onsite weekly. Relocation and mobility assistance are not provided.

Main Responsibilities:

• Ensure efficient, cost-effective clinical trial supply planning and management for low to medium complexity studies

• Performs planning and forecasting of drug volume requirements

• Sample collection and analysis

• Ensures proper storage, transportation and archiving

• Assists with selection and management of external service providers in compliance with outsourcing strategy to ensure cost efficient and high quality services

• Leverages interactive response technology (IRT) system to support clinical supply management activities

• Authors/reviews critical study documents (e.g. study protocol, product dossiers, handling instructions, study reports)

• Leads or participates in global Clinical Trial Supply project meetings with internal and external team members

• Partners with R&D and other functions to ensure optimal use of systems and processes to support clinical trial supply chain

• Supports continuous improvements in clinical drug supply and revises SOPs to ensure ongoing compliance and efficient conduct of clinical trial supply activities

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelors Degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, Logistics or equivalent experience

• 5+ years of experience in clinical supply management with the pharmaceutical industry

• Demonstrated knowledge of ICH-GCP regulations and the conduct of clinical studies

• Demonstrated knowledge of cGMP and cGDP regulations

• Team-player with proven effective interpersonal and communication skills

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.
To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-belonging

Equal Opportunity Employer
CSL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please visit https://www.csl.com/accessibility-statement .

Work Environment:

* This is a hybrid position based onsite at any of the posted locations with a minimum of 3 days onsite weekly. Relocation and mobility assistance are not provided.

Main Responsibilities:

• Ensure efficient, cost-effective clinical trial supply planning and management for low to medium complexity studies

• Performs planning and forecasting of drug volume requirements

• Sample collection and analysis

• Ensures proper storage, transportation and archiving

• Assists with selection and management of external service providers in compliance with outsourcing strategy to ensure cost efficient and high quality services

• Leverages interactive response technology (IRT) system to support clinical supply management activities

• Authors/reviews critical study documents (e.g. study protocol, product dossiers, handling instructions, study reports)

• Leads or participates in global Clinical Trial Supply project meetings with internal and external team members

• Partners with R&D and other functions to ensure optimal use of systems and processes to support clinical trial supply chain

• Supports continuous improvements in clinical drug supply and revises SOPs to ensure ongoing compliance and efficient conduct of clinical trial supply activities

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelors Degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, Logistics or equivalent experience

• 5+ years of experience in clinical supply management with the pharmaceutical industry

• Demonstrated knowledge of ICH-GCP regulations and the conduct of clinical studies

• Demonstrated knowledge of cGMP and cGDP regulations

• Team-player with proven effective interpersonal and communication skills

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.

jobs.title: Scientist, Analytical Science & Method Transfer
jobs.description:
We are currently looking for an experienced analytical science professional specializing in analytical method validation and transfer to contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs/CDMOs). Strong focus on troubleshooting, root-cause investigation, and ensuring robust analytical performance across external laboratories and CMOs under GMP conditions. In this position you will be directly reporting to the CMC Strategy and Technology Transfer Lead.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and coordinate analytical method transfer activities to or between Quality Control laboratories and external contract manufacturers

• Act as SME (Subject Matter Expert) for analytical issues during technology transfer and commercial manufacturing of drug substances and drug products

• Perform scientific troubleshooting for analytical methods (e.g., HPLC, GC, spectroscopy) in response to OOS, OOT, and atypical results

• Support CMOs/CDMOs in establishing analytical methods, resolving analytical challenges, ensuring alignment with internal standards and regulatory dossiers

• In case of method transfer by revalidation: design, optimize, and validate analytical methods according to ICH guidelines and GMP requirements

• Review and approve method transfer protocols, validation reports, and analytical documentation

• Drive root cause analysis and define CAPAs for analytical deviations in collaboration with cross-functional teams

• Ensure consistent method lifecycle management, including continuous improvement and robustness enhancement

• Support regulatory submissions by preparing and reviewing analytical sections (e.g., CTD Module 3) for new laboratories and CMOs

• Act as a key interface for Analytical Science & Method Transfer between Technology transfer team, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, and external partners

Core Expertise

• Analytical method transfer strategies (internal labs and CMOs)

• Analytical method development, validation, and lifecycle management

• Advanced analytical techniques:

• HPLC / UPLC

• GC

• Dissolution

• Spectroscopy

• Troubleshooting & deviation management (OOS/OOT investigations)

• Data evaluation

• GMP, ICH guidelines, and regulatory compliance

Professional Skills

• Experience working with contract manufacturers (CMOs/CDMOs) in a global environment

• Strong scientific problem-solving and troubleshooting mindset

• Excellent communication skills for interfacing with internal teams and external partners

• Structured and results-driven project management capabilities

• High level of accountability, persistence, and attention to detail

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a regulated environment

Qualifications

• Degree in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related field (e.g., HTL, ETH, MSc or equivalent)

• Minimum 5 years of experience in analytical development or quality control within the pharmaceutical industry

• Proven track record in method transfer and analytical troubleshooting

• Solid knowledge of GMP, ICH, and ISO standards

About CSL Vifor
CSL Vifor is a global partner of choice for pharmaceuticals and innovative, leading therapies in iron deficiency and nephrology. We specialize in strategic global partnering, in-licensing and developing, manufacturing and marketing pharmaceutical products for precision healthcare, aiming to help patients around the world lead better, healthier lives. Headquartered in St. Gallen, Switzerland, CSL Vifor also includes the joint company Vifor Fresenius Medical Care Renal Pharma (with Fresenius Medical Care). The parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

descriptionByLocale.it:
Siamo alla ricerca di un coordinatore di supporto per lo studio e il fornitore altamente organizzato e orientato al compito per supportare la gestione operativa di studi e programmi di sviluppo non clinici esterni. Questo ruolo è ideale per chi ama la creazione di strutture da informazioni complesse, la costruzione e il mantenimento di sistemi digitali, e aiutare i team funzionali rimanere allineati.

Un background scientifico e un'esperienza pratica in un laboratorio animale sono essenziali per comprendere il contesto di questo ruolo e l'urgenza dietro specifici materiali non clinici.

Questa posizione si concentra sulle operazioni non cliniche, sul coordinamento delle riunioni, sulla gestione della documentazione e sul supporto dei fornitori. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con il senior study manager, monitor di studio, rappresentanti di sviluppo aziendale da fornitori e lead funzionali. Una responsabilità centrale di questo ruolo è quella di assumere compiti amministrativi e di coordinamento da monitor di studio e lead funzionali in modo da poter concentrarsi sulle attività scientifiche e strategiche. Il candidato ideale è caldo, affidabile e gode di creare processi efficienti e ben organizzati.

Responsabilità:
Operazioni e supporto di studio

• Gestire il flusso operativo: revisione dei contratti → revisione legale/funzionale → esecuzione → creazione PO in SAP → notifica dei fornitori → approvazione della fattura SAP → consolidamento di tutti i documenti in strumenti di MS-office personalizzati.

• Mantenere la documentazione rigorosa e completa. Sostenere il coordinamento quotidiano di studi non clinici esterni e contribuire a migliorare le linee temporali globali dall'ideazione di studio al completamento.

• Consolidare le informazioni di studio, mantenere le linee temporali e i documenti costantemente aggiornati.

• Organizzare e coordinare incontri globali, tra cui la selezione dei servizi di vendita e le chiamate di allineamento.

• Proattivamente ridurre il carico di lavoro amministrativo per monitor di studio e cavi funzionali.

Fornitore e coordinamento dei contratti

• Raccogliere le proposte di servizio del fornitore, preparare i confronti di offerta-score e budget.

• Supporto contratto routing, monitoraggio delle versioni e raccolta di informazioni di proposte.

• Comunicare con fornitori esterni, comprese le discussioni in tedesco quando necessario.

• Consolidare le qualifiche e le informazioni di servizio del fornitore esterno in SharePoint.

• Creare e mantenere account fornitori esterni in SAP.

• Sostenere le attività di gestione del rischio di terze parti.

Strumenti digitali e gestione del flusso di lavoro
· Utilizzare strumenti come Microsoft SharePoint, dashboard MS-Excel, Power BI e modelli personalizzati per migliorare la visibilità delle informazioni e l'efficienza del flusso di lavoro. Rinforzare la conformità quando necessario.
· Contribuire a piccoli miglioramenti di processo nella documentazione, nella comunicazione e nei flussi di lavoro operativi.

Supporto amministrativo e di riunione

• Pianificare le riunioni globali, preparare gli ordini del giorno e documenti di azione.

• Traccia le tappe dello studio, le scadenze e le attività di follow-up.

• Mantenere i tracker interni e garantire una comunicazione chiara e organizzata tra le squadre.

Ambito e flessibilità

• Sopra descrive le principali aspettative per il ruolo; tuttavia, le responsabilità possono essere adattate in base ai punti di forza specifici del candidato e alle esigenze in evoluzione del team, a condizione che si allineano con il nostro impegno funzionale.

Requisiti di profilo
Istruzione

• Laurea in campo scientifico (ad esempio, Scienze della vita, Biologia, Chimica).

• Esperienza di ricerca (esp. lavoro animale di laboratorio, tesi di laurea in farmacologia / tossicologia, o stage scientifico in laboratorio di ricerca ).

Esperienza:

• Forte mentalità amministrativa e orientata al compito è altamente richiesto.

• L'esperienza nella gestione di studi clinici o non clinici è un plus ma non richiesto.

• L'esperienza di lavoro nell'organizzazione di ricerca di contratti non clinici è un plus ma non richiesto.

• L'esperienza nella gestione del progetto è desiderata

• L'esperienza con SAP sarà di grande vantaggio ma non è necessaria.

• Ben adatto per i ricercatori accademici che passano nella gestione dello studio scientifico.

Competenze

• Forte affinità per operazioni, processi strutturati e lavoro azionato.

• Capacità di influenzare gli stakeholder e il supporto compiacente

descriptionByLocale.de:
Wir suchen einen hoch organisierten, aufgabenorientierten Study & Vendor Support Coordinator, der das operative Management von ausgelagerten nichtklinischen Studien und Entwicklungsprogrammen unterstützt. Diese Rolle ist ideal für jemanden, der es genießt, Strukturen aus komplexen Informationen zu erstellen, digitale Systeme aufzubauen und zu warten und funktionalen Teams zu helfen, ausgerichtet zu bleiben.

Ein wissenschaftlicher Hintergrund und praktische Erfahrungen in einem Tierlabor sind unerlässlich, um den Kontext dieser Rolle und die Dringlichkeit bestimmter nichtklinischer Ergebnisse zu verstehen.

Diese Position konzentriert sich auf nichtklinische Operationen, Meeting-Koordination, Dokumentationsmanagement und Lieferantensupport. Sie werden eng mit dem leitenden Studienleiter, Studienmonitoren, Vertretern der Geschäftsentwicklung von Anbietern und funktionalen Leads zusammenarbeiten. Eine zentrale Aufgabe dieser Rolle ist es, Verwaltungs- und Koordinationsaufgaben von Studienmonitoren und funktionellen Leitern zu übernehmen, damit sie sich auf wissenschaftliche und strategische Aktivitäten konzentrieren können. Der ideale Kandidat ist warm, zuverlässig und genießt es, effiziente, gut organisierte Prozesse zu schaffen.

Zuständigkeiten:
Operations & Study Support

• Verwalten Sie den operativen Ablauf: Contract Sourcing Review → Legal/Functional Review → Execution → PO Creation in SAP → Vendor Notification → SAP bill approval → Konsolidierung aller Dokumente in maßgeschneiderten MS-Office Tools.

• Pflegen Sie strenge und vollständige Dokumentation. Unterstützung der täglichen Koordination externer nichtklinischer Studien und Verbesserung der Gesamtzeitpläne von der Studienidee bis zum Abschluss.

• Konsolidieren Sie die Studieninformationen, halten Sie Zeitpläne und Dokumente konsistent aktualisiert.

• Organisieren und koordinieren Sie globale Meetings, einschließlich der Auswahl von Anbieterservices und Abstimmungsaufrufen.

• Reduzieren Sie proaktiv den administrativen Arbeitsaufwand für Studienmonitore und funktionale Leads.

Vendor & Contract Koordination

• Sammeln Sie Anbieter-Service-Vorschläge, bereiten Sie Bid-Score- und Budget-Vergleiche vor.

• Unterstützen Sie das Vertragsrouting, die Versionsverfolgung und die Sammlung von Vorschlägen.

• Kommunizieren Sie mit externen Anbietern, einschließlich Diskussionen auf Deutsch, wenn nötig.

• Konsolidieren Sie externe Anbieterqualifikations- und Serviceinformationen in SharePoint.

• Erstellen und pflegen Sie externe Lieferantenkonten in SAP.

• Unterstützung von Risikomanagementaktivitäten von Drittanbietern.

Digitale Tools & Workflow Management
Verwenden Sie Tools wie Microsoft SharePoint, MS-Excel Dashboards, Power BI und kundenspezifische Vorlagen, um die Transparenz der Informationen und die Workflow-Effizienz zu verbessern. Verstärkte Einhaltung, wenn erforderlich.
· Beitrag zu kleinen Prozessverbesserungen in Dokumentation, Kommunikation und operativen Workflows.

Administrative & Meeting Support

• Planen Sie globale Meetings, bereiten Sie Tagesordnungen vor und dokumentieren Sie Aktionspunkte.

• Verfolgen Sie Meilensteine, Fristen und Folgeaktivitäten der Studie.

• Pflegen Sie interne Tracker und sorgen Sie für eine klare, organisierte Kommunikation zwischen den Teams.

Anwendungsbereich und Flexibilität

• Oben werden die Kernerwartungen für die Rolle beschrieben; die Verantwortlichkeiten können jedoch auf der Grundlage der spezifischen Stärken des Kandidaten und der sich entwickelnden Bedürfnisse des Teams zugeschnitten werden, sofern sie mit unserem funktionalen Aufgabenbereich übereinstimmen.

Anforderungen an das Profil
Bildung

• Bachelor-Abschluss in einem wissenschaftlichen Bereich (z. B. Life Sciences, Biologie, Chemie).

• Forschungserfahrung (z. B. Labortierarbeit, Bachelorarbeit in Pharmakologie / Toxikologie oder wissenschaftliches Praktikum im Forschungslabor).

Erfahrung:

• Eine starke administrative und aufgabenorientierte Denkweise ist dringend erforderlich.

• Erfahrung im klinischen oder nichtklinischen Studienmanagement ist ein Plus, aber nicht erforderlich.

• Erfahrung in nicht-klinischen Auftragsforschung Organisation ist ein Plus, aber nicht erforderlich.

• Erfahrung im Projektmanagement ist erwünscht

• Erfahrung mit SAP wird von Vorteil sein, aber nicht erforderlich.

• Gut geeignet für akademische Forscher, die in das wissenschaftliche Studienmanagement übergehen.

Kompetenzen

• Starke Affinität zu Operationen, strukturierten Prozessen und aufgabengesteuerter Arbeit.

• Fähigkeit, Stakeholder zu beeinflussen und Complian zu unterstützen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un coordonnateur d'étude et de soutien des fournisseurs hautement organisé et axé sur les tâches pour appuyer la gestion opérationnelle des études non cliniques et des programmes de développement externalisés. Ce rôle est idéal pour quelqu'un qui aime créer une structure à partir d'informations complexes, construire et maintenir des systèmes numériques, et aider les équipes fonctionnelles à rester alignées.

Un contexte scientifique et une expérience pratique dans un laboratoire d'animaux sont essentiels pour comprendre le contexte de ce rôle et l'urgence de certains produits non cliniques.

Ce poste est axé sur les opérations non cliniques, la coordination des réunions, la gestion de la documentation et le soutien des fournisseurs. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec le directeur principal de l'étude, les moniteurs d'étude, les représentants du développement des affaires des fournisseurs et les responsables fonctionnels. Une responsabilité centrale de ce rôle est de prendre en charge les tâches administratives et de coordination des moniteurs d'études et des responsables fonctionnels afin qu'ils puissent se concentrer sur les activités scientifiques et stratégiques. Le candidat idéal est chaleureux, fiable et aime créer des processus efficaces et bien organisés.

Responsabilités :
Opérations et soutien aux études

• Gérer le flux opérationnel : examen du sourcing des contrats → revue juridique/fonctionnelle → exécution → création de PO dans SAP → notification du fournisseur → approbation de facture SAP → consolidation de tous les documents dans des outils MS-office personnalisés.

• Maintenir une documentation stricte et complète. Appuyer la coordination quotidienne des études non cliniques externes et aider à améliorer le calendrier global de l'idée d'étude jusqu'à l'achèvement.

• Consolider l'information sur l'étude, tenir à jour les échéanciers et les documents.

• Organiser et coordonner des réunions mondiales, y compris la sélection des fournisseurs et les appels d'alignement.

• Réduire proactivement la charge de travail administrative des moniteurs d'études et des responsables fonctionnels.

Coordination des fournisseurs et des contrats

• Recueillir les propositions de services aux fournisseurs, établir des comparaisons entre les soumissions et les budgets.

• Soutenir l'acheminement des contrats, le suivi des versions et la collecte d'information sur les propositions.

• Communiquer avec les fournisseurs externes, y compris les discussions en allemand au besoin.

• Consolider les informations sur la qualification et le service des fournisseurs externes dans SharePoint.

• Créer et maintenir des comptes fournisseurs externes dans SAP.

• Appuyer les activités de gestion des risques par des tiers.

Outils numériques et gestion des flux de travail
· Utilisez des outils tels que Microsoft SharePoint, les tableaux de bord MS-Excel, Power BI et des modèles personnalisés pour améliorer la visibilité de l'information et l'efficacité du workflow. Renforcer la conformité au besoin.
· Contribuer aux petites améliorations des processus dans la documentation, la communication et les workflows opérationnels.

Soutien administratif & réunions

• Planifier les réunions mondiales, préparer les ordres du jour et documenter les mesures à prendre.

• Suivre les étapes de l'étude, les échéances et les activités de suivi.

• Maintenir des suivis internes et assurer une communication claire et organisée entre les équipes.

Portée et souplesse

• Nous décrivons ci-dessus les principales attentes à l'égard du rôle, mais les responsabilités peuvent être adaptées en fonction des forces spécifiques du candidat et de l'évolution des besoins de l'équipe, à condition qu'elles correspondent à notre mandat fonctionnel.

Exigences relatives au profil
Éducation

• Baccalauréat dans un domaine scientifique (p. ex. sciences de la vie, biologie, chimie).

• Expérience de recherche (prés. travail animal de laboratoire, thèse de baccalauréat en pharmacologie/toxicologie, ou stage scientifique en laboratoire de recherche).

Expérience :

• Une bonne attitude administrative et axée sur les tâches est très nécessaire.

• L'expérience de la gestion des études cliniques ou non cliniques est un atout mais non nécessaire.

• L'expérience de travail au sein d'un organisme de recherche à contrat non clinique est un plus, mais pas nécessaire.

• Une expérience de la gestion de projet est souhaitée

• L'expérience acquise avec SAP sera avantageuse mais non nécessaire.

• Bien adapté pour les chercheurs universitaires en transition vers la gestion des études scientifiques.

Compétences

• Une forte affinité pour les opérations, les processus structurés et le travail axé sur les tâches.

• Capacité d'influencer les parties prenantes et de soutenir la réalisation

Principal Data Scientist

Position Purpose

The Principal Data Scientist is responsible for driving advanced analytics, data engineering, application development and AI solutions across TechOps. This role provides technical leadership for strategic data initiatives that improve operational performance, enable digital manufacturing and support data-driven decision making.

Data Engineering & Platform Leadership

• Design, build and maintain scalable enterprise data platforms and data products using Databricks, AWS and cloud-native technologies.

• Architect robust data pipelines for ingestion, transformation and delivery of structured and unstructured data.

• Establish data engineering standards, development frameworks and best practices across TechOps.

• Ensure data quality, integrity, security and governance requirements.

Advanced Analytics, AI & Generative AI Solutions

• Lead the design and deployment of advanced analytics, machine learning and Generative AI solutions supporting TechOps objectives.

• Develop AI-enabled applications using LLMs and RAG frameworks.

• Establish monitoring, governance and lifecycle management practices for AI solutions.

Application Development & Digital Solutions

• Lead development of enterprise analytics applications using Python, React, Power BI and R Shiny.

• Design and develop APIs and integration services.

• Ensure modern engineering practices including testing and CI/CD.

Technical Leadership & Strategy

• Define and execute TechOps analytics and digital solution roadmaps.

• Lead complex cross-functional projects from concept through production deployment.

• Drive standardisation and reuse of analytics assets and frameworks.

People Leadership & Capability Building

• Mentor Data Scientists, Data Engineers and Analytics Developers.

• Conduct technical reviews and promote engineering excellence.

Required Skills & Experience

• Advanced experience with Databricks and cloud analytics platforms.

• Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.

• Extensive experience designing scalable data pipelines and platforms.

• Experience developing enterprise applications and APIs.

• Experience with Power BI.

• Experience delivering AI or Generative AI solutions in production.

• Understanding of data governance, security and architecture principles.

Qualifications, Skills & Experience

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Analytics or related discipline.

• 7-10+ years experience in data analytics, data engineering, software development or digital solution delivery.

• Experience leading complex cross-functional analytics initiatives.

• Experience in manufacturing, biotechnology or regulated industries preferred.

The Principal Data Scientist is responsible for driving advanced analytics, data engineering, application development and AI solutions across TechOps. This role provides technical leadership for strategic data initiatives that improve operational performance, enable digital manufacturing and support data-driven decision making.

Data Engineering & Platform Leadership

• Design, build and maintain scalable enterprise data platforms and data products using Databricks, AWS and cloud-native technologies.

• Architect robust data pipelines for ingestion, transformation and delivery of structured and unstructured data.

• Establish data engineering standards, development frameworks and best practices across TechOps.

Advanced Analytics, AI & Generative AI Solutions

• Develop AI-enabled applications using LLMs and RAG frameworks.

• Establish monitoring, governance and lifecycle management practices for AI solutions.

• Lead development of enterprise analytics applications using Python, React, Power BI and R Shiny.

• Design and develop APIs and integration services.

• Ensure modern engineering practices including testing and CI/CD.

• Lead complex cross-functional projects from concept through production deployment.

Qualifications, Skills & Experience

CSL's R&D organization is accelerating innovation to deliver greater impact for patients. With a project-led structure and a focus on collaboration, we’re building a future-ready team that thrives in dynamic biotech ecosystems. Joining CSL now means being part of an agile team committed to developing therapies that make a meaningful difference worldwide.

Could you be our next Senior Director Search & Evaluation Late TA Lead, Immunology? The job is in our Waltham MA, King of Prussia PA, Glattburg Switzerland or Maidenhead UK Office. This is a hybrid position and is onsite three days a week.

Position Description Summary ​

Senior Directors of Search & Evaluation to lead strategic sourcing and evaluation of later-stage external Hematology therapeutic area. You will focus on opportunities from Phase 2 through marketed drugs, requiring deep clinical expertise, strong engagement with external Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and clinical investigators, and a keen understanding of evolving standards of care. The role is critical to shaping our portfolio through high-impact partnerships and transactions. ​

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities ​

• Serve as the senior S&E leader within the TALT, influencing therapeutic strategy and integrating late-stage external innovation priorities into portfolio planning. ​

• Lead proactive sourcing efforts for Phase 2 to marketed assets, identifying opportunities that align with TA strategy and unmet medical needs. ​

• Co-lead internal meetings (with Early Search Lead) focused on evaluating and prioritizing New Product Opportunities (NPOs) within each CSL’s therapeutic areas. NPO meetings are strategic checkpoints where cross-functional teams review potential assets identified by Search and decide whether to advance them for further due diligence and deal negotiations ​

• Engage extensively with external KOLs, clinical investigators, and networks to validate asset potential, understand trial designs & clinical endpoints, and anticipate competitive dynamics. ​

• Maintain deep awareness of changing standards of care and competitive landscapes to inform sourcing priorities and deal strategy. ​

• Drive cross-functional due diligence for late-stage assets, coordinating clinical, regulatory, commercial, and market access assessments to support governance decisions. ​

• Partner closely with BD and Regional Ecosystem Leads to advance high-priority opportunities through negotiation and deal close, ensuring seamless handoff and execution ​

• Represent the TA externally, leading sourcing activities at specialized conferences and building relationships with pharma, biotech, and clinical communities. ​

Qualifications & Experience Requirements ​

• 15+ years in biopharma with significant experience in clinical development, external innovation, or business development. ​

• Advanced degree required (MD, PhD, or equivalent). ​

• Deep clinical expertise in Immunology, Hematology, or Cardiovascular/Renal therapeutic areas. ​

• Proven track record of sourcing and closing late-stage deals and engaging with KOLs and clinical networks. ​

• Strong understanding of regulatory pathways, market access, and competitive standards of care. ​

We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

Con una struttura guidata da progetti e un focus sulla collaborazione, stiamo costruendo un team pronto per il futuro che prospera in ecosistemi biotecnologici dinamici. Unirsi ora a CSL significa far parte di un team agile impegnato a sviluppare terapie che facciano una differenza significativa in tutto il mondo. Potresti essere il nostro prossimo Direttore senior Ricerca e valutazione Responsabile AT tardivo, Immunologia? Il lavoro è nel nostro ufficio di Waltham MA, King of Prussia PA, Glattburg Svizzera o Maidenhead nel Regno Unito. Questa è una posizione ibrida ed è in sede tre giorni alla settimana. Descrizione della posizione Riepilogo Direttori senior di ricerca e valutazione per guidare l'approvvigionamento strategico e la valutazione dell'area terapeutica esterna di ematologia in fase avanzata. Ti concentrerai sulle opportunità dalla Fase 2 ai farmaci commercializzati, che richiedono una profonda esperienza clinica, un forte coinvolgimento con Key Opinion Leader (KOL) esterni e investigatori clinici e una profonda comprensione degli standard di cura in evoluzione. Il ruolo è fondamentale per modellare il nostro portafoglio attraverso partnership e transazioni ad alto impatto. ​ Principali responsabilità e responsabilità ​

Le riunioni NPO sono punti di controllo strategici in cui team interfunzionali esaminano le potenziali risorse identificate dalla Ricerca e decidono se promuoverle per ulteriori due diligence e negoziazioni di accordi.
• Coinvolgere ampiamente con KOL esterni, investigatori clinici e reti per convalidare il potenziale delle risorse, comprendere i progetti di sperimentazione e gli endpoint clinici e anticipare le dinamiche competitive. ​
• Mantenere una profonda consapevolezza dei cambiamenti degli standard di cura e del panorama competitivo per informare le priorità di approvvigionamento e la strategia di negoziazione. ​
• Promuovere la due diligence interfunzionale per le risorse in fase avanzata, coordinando le valutazioni cliniche, normative, commerciali e di accesso al mercato per supportare le decisioni di governance. ​
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con BD e i leader dell'ecosistema regionale per promuovere opportunità ad alta priorità attraverso la negoziazione e la conclusione degli accordi, garantendo un passaggio e un'esecuzione senza intoppi. ​
• Rappresentare l'AT all'esterno, guidando attività di sourcing in conferenze specializzate e costruendo rapporti con comunità farmaceutiche, biotecnologiche e cliniche. ​ Qualifiche e requisiti di esperienza ​
• Oltre 15 anni nel settore biofarmaceutico con esperienza significativa nello sviluppo clinico, nell'innovazione esterna o nello sviluppo aziendale. ​
• Laurea avanzata richiesta (medicinale, dottorato di ricerca o equivalente). ​
• Approfondita esperienza clinica nelle aree terapeutiche immunologica, ematologica o cardiovascolare/renale. ​
• Comprovata esperienza nell'approvvigionamento e nella chiusura di accordi in fase avanzata e nel coinvolgimento di KOL e reti cliniche. ​
• Forte conoscenza dei percorsi normativi, dell'accesso al mercato e degli standard di cura competitivi. ​ L'intervallo di stipendio base previsto per questa posizione al momento dell'assunzione è $ 263.000 - $ 328.000.
